battle:d820e54ccef14314.text: 「Scurrying around like you think you're so clever!」

battle:4d9bf6c95b73dc2c.text: 「This is how $$ファイヤバグ$$ does it!」

battle:bbeb3de02b06c90e.text: 「Let's do this the $$ファイヤバグ$$ way!」

battle:4291fad31cf5350a.text: 「You'll learn the power of $$ファイヤバグ$$!」

battle:1513eef3e884004c.text: 「Remember the name $$ファイヤバグ$$, and tremble!」

battle:d8a8b562d2736bef.text: 「Sorry, but this is part of the job!」

battle:55407b8ec5135cb2.text: 「I decide whether you live or die!」

battle:5946d3bff0fac31c.text: 「You're like ants scrambling to get away!」

battle:31a5fe679ceb3c89.text: 「Run, and I'll just shoot you in the back!」

battle:f77af8d48a7b3ad7.text: 「I'll show you why mercenaries are feared!」

battle:bd2967da5fa7164f.text: 「Don't mistake the $$バーグラー$$\nfor an ordinary $$アクシオ$$!」

battle:faae957d7f03698f.text: 「To us, this $$バーグラー$$ is like another limb!」

battle:50913fa818293a56.text: 「Close combat really shows the difference in skill!」

battle:4e94cf68245102f4.text: 「I won't let up until you go down!」

battle:437e8b6edc3abda6.text: 「That's what a difference in skill looks like!」

battle:e00349d2c2d7f49b.text: 「You're taking me on at that size!?」

battle:d612f6d5d73b026f.text: 「No matter how fast you are, you leave an opening...!」

battle:6f822739e275efcf.text: 「Take down their leader, and the battle's decided!」

battle:77013e976f126326.text: 「Looks like I'm up against an ace!」

battle:ef9e7c56164bcbff.text: 「What's wrong? You didn't finish the job!」

battle:970d60eb2e491b5a.text: 「Damn it! You used me as a shield!」

battle:ff4bf5bfedd78840.text: 「You used me to take the bullets...!?」

battle:9847c9ec759e5eef.text: 「Tch! I'm not just going to be a target!」

battle:31248817bce95c50.text: 「What!? All I can do is watch them go!?」

battle:b294ed4b6896b290.text: 「Not good! My machine's badly worn down!」

battle:adda82f984d8a139.text: 「Piece of junk! Not a decent weapon on it!」

battle:762d4007a2235f15.text: 「Damn it! Are you toying with me!?」

battle:5a7f994d9c740315.text: 「Attacking from there...!?\nI didn't see that coming!」

battle:831fbd14408a738f.text: 「You know the basics of combat!\nAnother professional, huh?」

battle:7d2573c9d286368c.text: 「Pathetic...! Your aim, your moves, your resolve!」

battle:c5568062555d20ce.text: 「You're not worthy of being my opponent!」

battle:83ca59ad7fcae4f4.text: 「You can't see a thing, can you!」

battle:2bd4b77c07fd13ad.text: 「I didn't survive all those brushes with death for nothing!」

battle:743722a431aba3e8.text: 「Tch...! You made me use my barrier!」

battle:846280116c7821ee.text: 「Don't tell me that's your full strength!」

battle:370f39e552ff82ae.text: 「That's not enough to take me down!」

battle:c8ac2c0d7a8d73b9.text: 「Looks like you're underestimating $$ファイヤバグ$$!」

battle:ad81ee8ace08042c.text: 「At least try to slow me down!」

battle:c758e16d2d45a8a7.text: 「Tch! So that's how you're playing it!」

battle:3ed2827418a35529.text: 「This is bad!\nThere's too much strain on the joints!」

battle:02070e644102f514.text: 「Looks like you've got some fight in you!」

battle:e4e0070f62fab456.text: 「Heh... I can feel the adrenaline pumping!」

battle:4705ae46f29ed5d8.text: 「This is bad... The Grim Reaper's calling.」

battle:77606a15b7d34c61.text: 「I've got one foot in the grave...!」

battle:e4ee71eed2299954.notes: Independent proof: You'll pay for that is an idiomatic hostile reaction for やってくれやがる; adds a retaliatory flavor but not a specific promised action. Judged acceptable battle speech, not rewritten merely for literalness.

battle:7196aedc736e4a65.text: 「This takes me back...\nTo that hellish $$タリビア$$ front!」
battle:7196aedc736e4a65.notes: Root researched タリビア as Taribia; use its glossary reference.

battle:3e1e5893cefd49ce.text: 「Oh, yeah!\nThe adrenaline's racing through my brain!」

battle:e215fb5ec4349b51.text: 「I gave my life to the Princess long ago!」
battle:e215fb5ec4349b51.notes: Independent proof: Princess translates 姫 as the Firebug leader's address/nickname; this does not establish royal status. Kept draft wording and did not insert the leader's proper name.

battle:4373972074bb26bd.text: 「I've survived every battle...\nHow can this happen to me?!」

battle:c9000fa1b1ad96be.text: 「Damn you!\nWhat the hell did you do?!」

battle:72280afb49b635be.text: 「Me... A member of $$ファイヤバグ$$...!」

battle:47bd411f3f5f23a8.text: 「Damage has exceeded the limit! Is this it?!」

battle:fd8921bf4dc2e66e.text: 「I can't afford to pick my battlefields!」

battle:63b259f11903629b.text: 「All I can do now is go as far as I can!」

battle:7b9f0fd61ca81bac.text: 「We'll keep fighting, even without the Princess!」

battle:f238f237bf50b1f9.text: 「Our hearts are always with the Princess!」

battle:afff260706bdcd64.text: 「We're still $$ファイヤバグ$$, no matter how far we've fallen!」

battle:ce063949768164ea.text: 「I'll show them $$ファイヤバグ$$'s strength once again!」

battle:feb9ac8bb26a9bdd.text: 「$$ファイヤバグ$$ isn't dead yet!」

battle:a77836f4da11543f.text: 「We can't let the name\n$$ファイヤバグ$$ disappear!」

battle:c71521e2339b521e.text: 「The Princess taught us: an eye for an eye!」

battle:7b1a7a25bac9e9c3.text: 「Letting you leave like this\nwould disgrace $$ファイヤバグ$$!」

battle:87e54ab7ae129d28.text: 「Try that a hundred times and you'll get the same result.」

battle:2b3ed051b8049a1f.notes: Root researched バーグラー as Burglar; use its glossary reference.

battle:55c78a7a23547249.text: 「Tch...! I let an attack like that hit me...!」

battle:ed72f26b5c6b29a4.text: 「It's been one ordeal after another since we lost the Princess...!」

battle:f34518297d79bfd2.text: 「If the Princess were commanding us, these clowns wouldn't...!」

battle:1801188a9d3dcfd5.text: 「Damn it! I just can't get fired up!」

battle:869f0382202db4ee.text: 「Tch!\nAre you saying $$ファイヤバグ$$ is finished?!」

battle:30384126a32bdbe1.text: 「If the Princess were commanding us...\nNo, if only she were here...!」

battle:47b995f247270ac0.text: 「If only the Princess were here...! This wouldn't have happened!!」

battle:938df4e0bc3ce3ae.text: 「F-$$ファイヤバグ$$... isn't finished yet!」

battle:3e26cb60d1e04af5.text: 「Raaah! $$ファイヤバグ$$ will never die!!」

battle:7f633ef31a6dbcc4.text: 「Let's make this a fun little party!」

battle:7704a44972a748bf.text: 「That's how $$ファイヤバグ$$ does things!」

battle:b78de03c71afa4af.text: 「$$ファイヤバグ$$ ain't some little firefly!」

battle:dab58077b9738b7d.text: 「Sorry! I've got a job to do, too!」

battle:f25184fa4d97efc9.text: 「Come on, come on! Space out and you're dead!」

battle:639f5f36b825b86c.text: 「You do the running! I do the shooting!」

battle:e2efc0cff8dbbacf.text: 「Time for you to dance the fire dance!」

battle:6dd037c1e1539b22.text: 「Make some pretty fireworks out of that life of yours!」

battle:fe130856d0fee4d3.text: 「I just can't get enough of war!」

battle:bafaf3d2b4b28b68.text: 「$$バーグラー$$ means\na robber, you know!」
battle:bafaf3d2b4b28b68.notes: Independent proof: Source itself glosses Burglar as 強盗 (robber). Kept the source's loose definition rather than correcting the character's vocabulary.

battle:30238b32bc36fdaa.text: 「Just because it's an $$アクシオ$$,\ndon't think it's a pushover!」

battle:78ce6a6a88f505a3.text: 「Earn your keep, you piece of junk!」

battle:9cf5b13e408d4933.text: 「Hello there!\nI've got an invitation to hell for you!」

battle:da4915da3e8cc5b3.notes: どっこらセット / よっこいショット blends exertion cries with set/shot. English retains the playful ready/fire wordplay; there is no literal gameplay instruction to infer. Independent proof: Heave-ho/set and here-we-go/shot preserves effort-cry plus firing wordplay of どっこらセット / よっこいショット. No substantive omission found; humor can remain a stylistic review flag, not grounds for meaning rewrite.

battle:60ca6d646a788e99.text: 「Silly you! You're in my firing range! ♪」

battle:b631ec463b500249.text: 「Here comes a bang! A big ka-bang!」

battle:dec54aea3ef65d80.text: 「Whoa there! I'm not stopping after one!」

battle:3901f1c9f7244b9a.text: 「Care to join me for another round?」

battle:3be6feb989fb7475.text: 「Warm-up's over! Time for the real thing!」

battle:2cb69f78c74259cb.text: 「Don't think being big means you'll win!」

battle:6ec931edfe8d29fd.text: 「Oh, no!\nChasing you around is making me dizzy!」

battle:a8da5c2d5df25554.text: 「You know...\nI get pretty bold around little guys!」

battle:aa7d820759942191.text: 「I get a bonus for taking down commander types!」

battle:ff5b2186f4c2686d.text: 「It takes an ace to handle an ace!」

battle:81b259cb590c7465.text: 「Sink a battleship and I'm a hero!」

battle:6b817a1529c1cfd0.text: 「A direct hit on the bridge\nand it's a piece of cake!」

battle:5c64c7db27ef2ccd.text: 「You rang? Here I am, and all that!」

battle:b4969b9733b09857.text: 「I'll win with as little effort as possible!」

battle:f87cc356d32007f8.text: 「Huh?! Since when am I the shield?!」

battle:79775d440067d4e0.text: 「Huh? Huh?! I'm really off my game today...」

battle:25434e2f13a2b87d.text: 「It's not that I can't counterattack! I just won't!」

battle:f59148436917a405.text: 「Uh...\nGuess you know the basics of combat...!」

battle:a769511e27f0ddce.text: 「Heh... Attacking from way over there?\nScared of me, are you?」

battle:86013cbbfedef318.text: 「Yes, yes! As you can see, I can't reach you!」

battle:8237de05d85f31de.text: 「Aw, man... What a waste of effort.」

battle:7378b7edd3b6ea1d.text: 「I just can't get excited about this.」

battle:b0da7d7001a2b0a9.text: 「No way! You call that an attack?!」

battle:bb46b5b12896e90b.text: 「The mosquitoes in $$クメン$$\nhit harder than that!」

battle:8d7cac92cdeb659f.text: 「I don't have time to play house!」

battle:0590b896526848a3.text: 「Not bad! I'll give you sixty points!」

battle:bdee91d034dcd23e.text: 「Ho ho! Now I'm getting fired up!」

battle:2d42ed1ed24465eb.text: 「No way! Was that what they call a lucky hit?!」

battle:70f69f28c3518e59.text: 「What's going on, honey?!\nI'm getting pushed back!」

battle:95c2cd098a3399cb.text: 「Oh, crap! Some of my insides just came out of my mouth!」

battle:1c3096d090bbf07f.text: 「Crap! I took you lightly because you're small!」

battle:7d9e5dafefbdc64b.text: 「What's going on?!\nAm I having a nightmare?!」

battle:a1f0e8a59dfadaea.text: 「Even that hellish $$タリビア$$ front\nwas better than this!」

battle:44528f80d24f5889.text: 「The good die young, and I'm no good!\nI'm not dying!」
battle:44528f80d24f5889.notes: Independent proof: The good die young / I'm no good reverses the Japanese proverb into a familiar English one while retaining the speaker's claim that a hated villain will survive. No new moral claim beyond self-mocking boast judged material.

battle:4654c2cfb1537f66.text: 「Damn it! You don't know when to hold back!」

battle:3d2ef015f67d1079.text: 「Tch!\nGetting all serious over a fight like this!」

battle:542c6e531a6b1088.text: 「Waaah!\nI might not make it this time!」

battle:b738cf090b15b2df.text: 「Oh, crap!\nAll I see is red, and my future's looking black!」

battle:704b37bc15904c2e.text: 「Okay, I've got it!\nI'll run at the first chance!」

battle:a5faec3561e8254a.text: 「Remember this!\nThe next time we meet... Aaaaah!!」

battle:9edf82f9c44fd129.notes: Source spells Japanese shine with S-I-N-E, then says die. English uses D-I-E then Die to preserve the deliberate spelling-out rather than a mathematical sine reference.

battle:b260ace6989f8e5f.text: 「$$ファイヤバグ$$ is burning bright today!」

battle:deb49b264078ce18.text: 「I'll fight with the Princess in my heart!」

battle:4726ac21aedd3677.text: 「As long as I'm here, $$ファイヤバグ$$ will never fall!」

battle:75112332a1d8af46.text: 「I'll keep thriving like the bastard I am!」

battle:4825fc63946cb764.text: 「The battlefield's the only place we belong!」

battle:1bad60790d89558e.text: 「Paying back double is all the rage!」

battle:da008bcc9843479d.text: 「It's my turn now!\nAnd it'll stay my turn!」

battle:ef5074c31536bfe0.text: 「You hit me, I hit back! That's my way!」

battle:d05b7176a0ca7deb.text: 「We'll gang up and beat you down!」

battle:2fe80955cfeea116.text: 「A full-course murder feast! I'm the first course!」

battle:03d16767783a8314.text: 「I love ganging up to torment one person!」

battle:28a030690f6dfdbd.notes: 無駄DEATH is a desu/death sound pun; DEAD useless keeps uselessness and the death joke. Tone/localization choice flagged. Independent proof: DEAD useless preserves the useless assertion plus explicit DEATH pun substituted for です, repeated twice. No meaning correction needed; pun wording is stylistic.

battle:aaad2ca2249aea3b.text: 「Hey, hey!\nIs your targeting lens fogged up?」

battle:4dcb3589463d4118.text: 「That scratch is gonna cost you, pal.」

battle:190cc6bdf1ce0190.text: 「No way! Am I getting pushed back?!」

battle:b6b85845c2dae3b4.text: 「Hold on! That was going too far!」

battle:1240a0ae59bef5ae.text: 「Aw, come on! If only the Princess were here...!」

battle:cf18ff860d428ea7.text: 「D-Damn it!\nIf the Princess were here, someone like you...!」

battle:50c93ac6e299749c.text: 「Yow!\nI'm in $$ファイヤバグ$$, and now my ass is on fire!」

battle:dbf81d871bb734b5.text: 「S-Seriously?! This is how it ends again?!」

battle:36a3c802ed577ddd.text: 「Daaaamn it!\nI'm nothing but the designated loser!」

battle:87e7e3f296bcbd45.text: 「Ah... I can see a vision of the Princess...」

battle:3f782f9a4a65aa85.text: 「Now, the time for battle has come!」

battle:cef364f18f70d3db.text: 「Fighting like this is also a joy to me...!」

battle:ad85cb55d7b6a2ea.text: 「I will not surrender our hope for the future!」

battle:b7517c1c17f9bda6.text: 「Anyone who would halt humanity's evolution\nis my enemy!」

battle:351855413f02911c.text: 「I will try as many times as it takes! That is how I fight!」

battle:62cbbd119d885fa6.text: 「You cannot evade this succession of blows...!」

battle:50b974aa8b9fd9b1.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:0639491270b9570d.text: 「$$スクランブル・エッジ$$! Go!」
battle:0639491270b9570d.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:0f3200a25c63be79.text: 「With the speed of $$アスクレプス$$...!」

battle:1085e2a26a999189.text: 「I will bring this into close combat!」
battle:1085e2a26a999189.notes: Independent proof: クロス・コンバット read as close combat, consistent with bringing the enemy into close range. Did not reinterpret this as an independently named Cross Combat technique without source evidence.

battle:3fe78d8f331adb18.text: 「$$フォールディング・スマッシャー$$!」
battle:3fe78d8f331adb18.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:03309c35f431fd25.text: 「The twin serpents will strike the enemy!」

battle:6aefc8bc4cb0f000.text: 「Jaws of the serpent, devour the enemy!」

battle:f8fd9c1e87e06a84.text: 「Fangs of the serpent, do not let my foe escape!」

battle:482b9cd666a2b200.text: 「$$リベレーター$$! Come to my hand!」
battle:482b9cd666a2b200.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:9126e3e474aeec0e.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:e98c6448cb4d631b.notes: Independent proof: 因果 retains causality throughout nearby lines347/352/383. No extra cosmological explanation or specific fate imposed on the character's claim.

battle:7df0ff8a0e2e5793.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:d7578dfedf9bebdc.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:f2763b235c1ddb4e.text: 「Here and now, I unravel the spiral of causality!」

battle:e0b19dd09617a239.text: 「$$リベレーター・ディスチャージ$$!」
battle:e0b19dd09617a239.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:02a088a0ba999aaf.text: 「Then it is my turn to attack!」

battle:f72a43ae6e2c245b.text: 「You were the one who attacked first...!」

battle:9e44dd40891424d7.text: 「If you are struck on the right cheek, turn the left...\nBut I cannot do that.」

battle:17bb7f7c6c6a8b10.text: 「I do not enjoy being attacked without retaliation.」

battle:f2e6f97c71436570.text: 「I will keep the enemy in check!」

battle:2aa60909971bf2dd.text: 「I will create an opening for you!」

battle:03e7fe8f8b26fc29.text: 「All I can do is watch the enemy leave. How disgraceful.」

battle:a11d7f44e5ce8fdd.text: 「It seems the enemy is more underhanded than I imagined.」

battle:10a5f3efebe05a77.text: 「I do not wish to die, either.」

battle:a2a66a386b1ad7fa.text: 「Sorry, but I cannot let you strike me down.」

battle:dc4933a5c7f1ba91.text: 「This is not enough\nto break my resolve.」

battle:21dfaeb9e17277fb.text: 「Even $$アスクレプス$$ could not evade that...!」

battle:d95e37e488864e6f.text: 「It seems my movements were a little sloppy.」

battle:c2e305fd67a4c876.text: 「I will not make a mistake like this again...!」

battle:85b5f0e737b18ff8.text: 「I can still maintain output! I have no intention of retreating!」

battle:10b106e44e87f379.text: 「A predicament like this is within my expectations!」

battle:1a9d4bb76650520c.text: 「I cannot afford\nto take any more damage!」

battle:40db00ada6b9fff9.text: 「As captain, I cannot afford to disgrace myself!」

battle:073fcd36b88d8631.text: 「To think $$アスクレプス$$ would take such a beating...!」

battle:430709e4e8210b75.text: 「Every one of my predictions is being overturned...!」

battle:5a9c66a24adf5992.text: 「So reality is not so kind\nas to let me win unscathed...!」

battle:e8104808f5d1c121.text: 「Guh! Can I hold out no longer?!」

battle:608d03ed7930c744.text: 「Am I failing to draw out\n$$アスクレプス$$'s power...?!」

battle:15415686dee4b3a9.text: 「At this rate...!\nNo, there is no room for doubt on the battlefield!」

battle:d53b4282eb312695.text: 「I cannot fall with my goal still unfulfilled...!」

battle:bc2347bd5e6ad898.text: 「Hold together, $$アスクレプス$$!\nJust a little longer!」

battle:bc5c0efb084fe49e.text: 「I have a mission\nto watch over humanity's evolution...!」

battle:fb0ce36afc0116fc.text: 「I will not give up hope until the very last moment!」

battle:9d4e421b3ab8e8fb.text: 「I will not surrender this $$翠の地球$$ to you!」

battle:953917909f17435a.text: 「Blue and Green...! I will protect both Earths!」

battle:36806c7070bd6004.text: 「Defeating $$サイデリアル$$ is our mission!」

battle:e065bd91c3c66931.text: 「Are you worthy of using a $$スフィア$$?」

battle:96b59251edafe9ef.text: 「$$サルディアス$$!\nYou brought this upon yourself!」

battle:29ffca45873024ce.text: 「$$クラヴィア$$!\nI will bury you here, along with your hatred!」

battle:c40f0846867baa0a.text: 「I will exploit the opening $$ランド$$ created.」

battle:e052ca737e308de8.text: 「I will lend a hand here, $$クロウ$$.」

battle:7a69c5f1c3973557.text: 「I will not let you suffer any more sorrow.」

battle:4be19eef2b5ce5dc.text: 「Though in your case, this is probably unnecessary.」

battle:152c8de18a1fa560.text: 「Unnecessary damage\nwill only add to your debts, will it not?」

battle:fdd95e0d45b59c89.text: 「Hello, players. My name is $$アドヴェント$$... I am the operations captain of $$クロノ$$, the watchers of humanity's evolution.」
battle:fdd95e0d45b59c89.notes: Independent proof: 行動隊長 retained operations captain; no new formal rank or organization identity inferred beyond the self-introduction.

battle:3db87d3545819e25.text: 「Haha... I usually remain in the shadows of human history, so being brought out on an occasion like this leaves me at a loss...」

battle:f5f97a1b8b5621f3.text: 「Then, as one who knows what lies ahead, I will give you some useful information. Guiding you is also a joy to me.」

battle:d023f0fabd50bfeb.text: 「Link your cleared Rengoku-hen data to Tengoku-hen, and something good will happen.」
battle:d023f0fabd50bfeb.notes: Source title 連獄篇 is this game's actual title, Rengoku-hen. English preserves that established title.

battle:79683c7e11ad9dff.text: 「But there is no need to rush through it. You can link your cleared Rengoku-hen data even partway through Tengoku-hen.」

battle:4cd8f92007fcb083.text: 「Then I will await you at the end of the myth. Until we meet again!」

battle:58b10d2514cdc4a7.notes: Meaning proof: 今…目覚める… leaves the awakening subject unstated. The complete neighboring bank6 text does not settle whether this is the speaker or machine/power; I awaken adds a specific identity. Neutral fragment retains the source ambiguity. battle:b3565389faa40c23.text: 「I'll give form to the hatred inside me!」

battle:b5b5712ae2e25a84.text: 「It's not my fault! It's not my fault!」

battle:482403f1c309e946.text: 「It's like the fog in my head is clearing!」

battle:e5b1a0f5415684ab.text: 「Your very existence gets on my nerves!」

battle:4260e6a2b4e663e3.text: 「I'll make sure to finish you here!」

battle:5dfd4709bdb3c4c0.text: 「Without your carrier, you won't be able to fight!」

battle:24746aa8e1ad9627.text: 「I won't let you use your $$スフィア$$!」

battle:583382f52ca48114.notes: Sarcastic さん addressed to a Reactor rendered through sarcastic syntax; no unsupported target gender added.

battle:8b9b071a9885c7e5.text: 「I'll test just how tough you are!」

battle:e4c8c587b5dcdee8.text: 「The scales' beam, pans, and pillar...\nI'll destroy them all!」

battle:de7fb0d5ce4fffd3.text: 「Have a taste of these offensive nanomachines!」

battle:263c2deedc91448f.text: 「This weapon is what $$シャウラス$$ is all about!」

battle:79f5b8ac56d7cf7b.text: 「It's too late to beg for your life!」

battle:40769eaa9cab73cb.text: 「I'll crush you with $$シャウラス$$'s power!」

battle:8264cccfc9def289.text: 「I hate you...! Every part of your existence!」

battle:1381b6a088788c8c.text: 「Do you want to anger me that badly?!」

battle:8e2089cd763efa94.text: 「You've done it now...! You've done it now!」

battle:2169886716f18a40.text: 「Don't think you'll get away with this!」

battle:4b9c4468f0719a86.text: 「I'll pay you back double... no, triple!」

battle:1209da786daa438b.text: 「I'm so irritated my head could split open!」

battle:5aec7a4f11ee59f0.text: 「If you want to die, I'll help you!」

battle:ed12ee35ff321830.text: 「If you're staying there, you must want to die!」

battle:d5327f489cb79c1c.text: 「I'll take the one you failed to shoot down!」

battle:6f68c5ca3feec7d1.text: 「Your killing leaves the job half done!」

battle:7cb206f5d981fe64.text: 「Lord $$バルビエル$$! Leave the rest to me!」

battle:766cb42f6cc4c79d.text: 「This chance Lord $$バルビエル$$ has given me...!」

battle:625b836d0f269c96.text: 「Tch...! You never finish the job, $$ギルター$$!」

battle:59b06969cff61e02.text: 「If you're going to dawdle, I'll go first!」

battle:328c5c28b2c17d9d.text: 「Why?! Why can't I kill that one?!」

battle:348649cf9ff2fd83.text: 「Damn it! Damn it!\nI can see the enemy right there...!」

battle:be973562f323157c.text: 「All I can do is watch the enemy leave...\nIt makes my blood boil!」

battle:2a6ae6484179cf67.text: 「An attack that predictable will never hit!」

battle:1bfc0c1f7973669d.text: 「You come at me without the skill to back it up!」

battle:e4815ee02da1261f.text: 「Just die without being able to do a thing!」

battle:8c3f6a3d4f529775.text: 「Hahaha! I feel a little better now!」

battle:ca7c4b07411715f4.text: 「Is that all a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ can do?!」

battle:d8c5449e09646f0d.text: 「You incompetent fool! You can't even master your $$スフィア$$!」

battle:c338afa888ce3a63.text: 「I'll just take that on my shield!」

battle:df58424ad3240f12.text: 「Going out of your way to anger me, are you?!」

battle:ced212cbd15c0720.text: 「If you want to shoot me down, land a direct hit!」

battle:4586dc4615e674c7.text: 「Hit me with more of your hatred!」

battle:ad8549c7f765720d.text: 「Do you think this is a game?!」

battle:81dd8db6abfe18e1.text: 「No matter how many of those attacks hit me...!」

battle:94c6803720e34f43.text: 「I hate you...! I hate you for targeting me!」

battle:8b4fde5e367c73d7.text: 「Hehehe...! Do you want to die that badly?!」

battle:ef7d723315ffa5d5.text: 「I'll pay you back in full for this!」

battle:fc7c8859eb3872b3.text: 「This pain feeds the hatred inside me!」

battle:5426a6a0a970be92.text: 「Even $$シャウラス$$ can't block it completely?!」

battle:4e21dc5794a833e5.text: 「How dare you damage my $$シャウラス$$!」

battle:88911ab838b6ff33.text: 「So this is a super robot's power!」

battle:355f2678d9fd562d.text: 「Damn! I can't keep up with that speed!」

battle:2aabe72d2407905e.text: 「Why am I being cornered by such a small machine?!」

battle:4f7b5ac3149c3edd.text: 「I'm being beaten by the $$スフィア$$'s power...!」

battle:c786c5f499fe981f.text: 「That bastard!\nHave they mastered their $$スフィア$$?!」

battle:c1f694515dc30652.text: 「I won't forgive you! I'll never forgive you!」

battle:bec5c9557ef985e6.text: 「Damn it!\nI refuse to die before I kill you!」

battle:e5e14e9f237e3008.text: 「My hatred is still alive!\nI can still fight!」

battle:5c6be2ecb1c4db78.text: 「Where does all that power come from?!」

battle:28bf023854a7fb92.text: 「My blood's boiling with rage and hatred!」

battle:e44e5859976bb8e9.text: 「A direct hit?! I took a direct hit?!」

battle:c9f562c7090c8161.text: 「Not yet! Both my machine and I can still move!」

battle:98ae8dc962c1f455.notes: Independent proof: モニターが半分死んだ could describe half the displays or half of a single display. Multiple-monitor reading is plausible in this generic cockpit line; no evidence warrants replacing it with a different precise hardware layout.

battle:adfade9adff53b22.text: 「This is bad! The power unit's on fire!」

battle:05c43b85ff967c0b.text: 「I can't win even with $$シャウラス$$?!」

battle:72f62753e5608e0f.text: 「$$シャウラス$$! Turn my hatred into power!」

battle:3817f6680e70c56c.text: 「E-eject! I don't want to die yet!」

battle:9e7af0c745addbc6.text: 「E-eject! I don't want to die yet!」

battle:e7daad83cb41c05e.text: 「$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$,\ncommencing attack!」

battle:5c8f6f19cba6ba79.text: 「All that remains is to eliminate the enemy!」

battle:91c733402ebd45da.text: 「Since we have met on the battlefield, I will show no mercy!」

battle:db7d4ba3506b5bb3.text: 「I have gathered a fair amount of data on the enemy machine!」

battle:b6461aac220e5a56.text: 「The enemy has already fallen into my trap!」

battle:ea4f89b7ffe16ed5.text: 「Pathetic. You do not even realize you are cornered!」

battle:5c8a4d36e0e77468.text: 「I will show you\nhow $$ジェミニス$$ fights!」

battle:e5d70759589af1d6.text: 「As a pilot of $$ディオスク$$,\nI cannot accept defeat!」

battle:532023bbc873c0c8.text: 「I will show you the pride of $$ジェミニス$$\nand the determination of the $$ジェミナイド$$s!」
battle:532023bbc873c0c8.notes: ジェミナイド demonym provisionally Geminaids; root asked to confirm exact key. Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:88c38336517bbcd2.text: 「Bearing the anguish of our lost homeworld in my heart...!」

battle:abdd0623732170d3.text: 「I have no intention of missing a chance to attack!」

battle:3afe9a5f273baaa7.text: 「I, too, am a woman renowned in $$ジェミニス$$!\nI cannot lose!」
battle:3afe9a5f273baaa7.notes: Independent proof: Woman is source-explicit 女, so gender in this line is supported independently of Annalotta's name.

battle:6a0c8c251d89c948.text: 「A battle between aces!\nYou are a worthy opponent!」

battle:64f020f4eba549e6.text: 「Do not think that level of mobility\nwill let you shake me!」

battle:0ac373ee395265f5.text: 「Naive!\nDid you think your speed could confound me?!」

battle:42b9ca871227f0d7.text: 「Learn that battles\nare not decided by size!」

battle:99ae5a518b1c3a75.text: 「Even when hunting the lowly $$サルダ$$,\nthe fierce $$エスム$$ gives its all!」
battle:99ae5a518b1c3a75.notes: Esum/Sarda glossary keys are provisional; source alien animals and full-effort hunting relation preserved. battle:d8c9e8fdbb6b8482.text: 「Aim for the bridge,\nand even a battleship will fall in one hit!」

battle:3743ddebbb0f30bf.text: 「A direct hit to the power unit will work, even on a battleship!」

battle:860b36990c20bbcc.text: 「A melee is just what I want!」

battle:4cbad0936ff2010f.text: 「I will cut you with the blade!」

battle:2a2df75d65d33dde.text: 「I will show you the culmination of $$ジェミニス$$ combat techniques!」

battle:6812622a44b7b36f.notes: Independent proof: Psychokinetic control correctly conveys 念動コントロール. Other assigned banks use telekinetic control; reported to root for a global terminology pass, not changed locally as a meaning defect.

battle:54170da0df314eeb.text: 「These are the $$ジェミニス・アーツ$$!」
battle:54170da0df314eeb.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:146b512d84b1bde0.text: 「I will show you my finely honed techniques!」

battle:fefc3248e18a06e1.text: 「You failed to shoot me down, so you lose!」

battle:98c066f6d67610e3.text: 「I will simply take out whoever attacks first!」

battle:bc1bd9c2d3c12b8d.text: 「Even this counterattack is part of my calculations!」

battle:90bf855101d05808.text: 「Realize that you have been lured in!」

battle:5d6331b1cc9e08f1.text: 「You sealed your fate by attacking me!」

battle:2f164e71b1ba43cb.text: 「I, $$アンナロッタ$$,\nhave no mercy for my enemies!」

battle:a0daed25dedb7044.text: 「I will commend only your nerve in attacking!」

battle:743b005567ef2754.text: 「$$ジェミニス$$ teamwork will finish you!」

battle:249fd4653df6694e.text: 「$$ガドライト$$! Leave the rest to me!」

battle:045dea462b67d8e0.text: 「Do not worry. It is simply my nature.」

battle:26750bd06c4fdd2b.text: 「An officer's duty is to protect their subordinates!」

battle:61c31fcc5878e264.text: 「I will not let you harm $$ガドライト$$!」

battle:fb53934df75cf6a4.text: 「This will be more than a diversion!」

battle:c9f6fd80587889fc.text: 「Good tactics. I will learn from them.」

battle:aa162816709a0a0d.text: 「Of all people, I have made\nsuch a trivial mistake...!」

battle:188c9f789972adff.text: 「Is that the extent of your combat skill?」

battle:b745d5a85118e834.text: 「You are not up to being my opponent.」

battle:2e1c2857cc8bcb87.text: 「With $$ディオスク$$, that is hardly surprising.」

battle:ac1f5e8a80861154.text: 「Just as I expect of $$ディオスク$$. Good response.」

battle:d874bcc2dc12079e.text: 「It seems I must change my tactical pattern.」

battle:218c95d383126d44.text: 「I will have to update the enemy machine's data.」

battle:14b0eba592221f6a.text: 「Minor damage. No change in tactics required.」

battle:3caaaf0fca8a7e18.text: 「All parts functioning normally.\nHardly enough to be called damage.」

battle:6710bad93bbccb9e.text: 「That movement was not in the data...!」

battle:7137f56fb3425a77.text: 「Oh... You managed to hit $$ディオスク$$.」

battle:880e6ea953e6cddf.text: 「This is not yet enough to call a crisis!」

battle:ca9fcee36d24f91b.text: 「Well done, Earthling! That is more like it!」

battle:0abaa2e67cb2cc35.text: 「I thought you ignorant inhabitants of the galactic fringe,\nbut you have some skill!」

battle:b6a625d6bf8cc552.text: 「To take this much damage,\neven with $$ディオスク$$!」

battle:7efd918f2d1fe3d0.text: 「So Earthlings are like us after all...!」
battle:7efd918f2d1fe3d0.notes: Independent proof: Earthlings are like us leaves the relevant shared quality unspecified, matching Japanese. No unsupported species/history explanation inserted.

battle:5db31f2c9b90ffe4.text: 「An enemy capable of cornering me,\nhere on the galactic fringe?!」

battle:ee376d7b87335f71.text: 「Guh!\nAt this rate I cannot maintain output!」

battle:c5ac131705f67994.text: 「The situation is unfavorable! But I can still fight!」

battle:f619e838116ced7f.text: 「I will keep fighting\nso that the despair of that day never happens again!」

battle:8b803666f56db609.text: 「Even $$ディオスク$$'s psychokinetic control\ncannot evade it completely!」

battle:e1ad51738b32c1fe.text: 「Is this an opponent\neven $$ディオスク$$ cannot defeat?!」

battle:5087c708e84d44a4.text: 「Such speed\nthat even my psychokinesis cannot track it!」

battle:52d331fe548e1788.text: 「How much combat power\nhave you packed into something that size?!」

battle:de607fc0246d3604.text: 「Damn! Can the machine hold out no longer?!」

battle:579593b033969e83.text: 「For me to commit such a blunder!」

battle:20c5535c3d259e53.text: 「Giving up already? Earthlings' endurance is truly pathetic.」

battle:b0aa1169a7a0b668.text: 「We of $$ジェミニス$$ would stay up for three days and nights and clear a game like this without stopping.」

battle:d4bb5cb1a2751c29.text: 「If that bothers you, show me an Earthling's determination. I await our rematch in the game.」

battle:866bd1e1737ec60f.text: 「...That is what I am supposed to say, but do take regular breaks so you can enjoy the game. Then, I wish you success when you return to the fight.」

battle:8572b77bbe0c629a.text: 「What are you doing, $$ガドライト$$?!\nAre you playing around?!」

battle:f1385bb699b65525.text: 「You are nothing but an imitation in appearance!」

battle:203db43d0b1b408f.text: 「I will not let you, of all people, do this!」

battle:f59302dc1e09abf7.text: 「You bear no resemblance\nto the hope of us $$ジェミナイド$$s!」
battle:f59302dc1e09abf7.notes: Geminaids follows local non-dialogue demonym; exact glossary key pending. Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:74bf898216aa580c.text: 「It seems the enemy is growing as well.」

battle:2e97596258bed4ac.text: 「They, too, are risking their lives\nto fight for their own planet...!」

battle:455de762622ecd59.text: 「We are no different\nin fighting with all we have to survive!」

battle:b8d37e8714af6608.text: 「N-no...!\nI must at least protect this child...!」
battle:b8d37e8714af6608.notes: Independent proof: この子 retained this child. Source line itself does not identify gender or give the parentage/pregnancy explanation; draft correctly leaves those details out.

battle:cda3f5fbb235c016.text: 「Earthlings!\nDo you mean to open the door to despair yourselves?!」

battle:6f934da38c0865a0.text: 「Impossible!\nTo take this much damage from an imitation...!」

battle:11554d084089df04.text: 「Being defeated by you\nwould be my greatest humiliation!」

battle:95704a9279d42188.text: 「As a $$ジェミナイド$$,\nI cannot lose to you of all people!」
battle:95704a9279d42188.notes: Geminaid follows local non-dialogue demonym; exact glossary key pending. Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:fccdb3148cb20a9a.text: 「So this is the power of Earth's super robots!」

battle:dfa4fb1c58368a39.text: 「Why is a machine with such power\nout here on the fringe...?!」

battle:a8f4fc11bd8795a5.text: 「This overwhelming power...!\nWhat in the world is it?!」

battle:3cba17184e9b728c.text: 「Tch...!\nThe $$ガンダム$$ name is not for show!」
battle:3cba17184e9b728c.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:99e6d57d630e22ae.text: 「You certainly live up to being a product of the civilization of fire,\n$$ガンダム$$!」
battle:99e6d57d630e22ae.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:6ab020e0233a157a.text: 「To the end of the causal horizon...」

battle:5fc2cb7d24050cd9.notes: Independent proof: 解き放て、その業を can evoke releasing karma or freeing it from restraint; draft Unleash that karma preserves direct-object construction. Broader metaphysical interpretation is not established by this bank, so no invented explanation added.

battle:f3853ebd51694fbd.text: 「The path ahead is darkness... Such is fate...」

battle:9f1130bd41b62168.text: 「Why do you not abandon the flesh...」

battle:9c0a2d9b5bdd926e.notes: Meaning proof: 終わる is intransitive and 輪廻が is its subject: the cycle itself ends. Ending... the cycle of rebirth reads as a transitive action by an omitted actor. Explicit subject preserves the original event without adding an agent.

battle:c783c5cbd3f3778d.text: 「I just have to shoot that down, right?」

battle:25cb491fa813b942.text: 「I already have you in my sights.」

battle:b9655e1756e11a76.text: 「Do you want to be attacked that badly?」

battle:b5ed50a8dd09d8df.text: 「You will not be forgiven for targeting me.」

battle:b8c8b77f2deee336.text: 「I have no intention of causing you trouble.」

battle:d9e2e509bba6c8cb.text: 「Nothing I can do in this situation.」

battle:6ac02458993d1d99.text: 「I only have to take it on the armor.」

battle:a1f4c8a4bfc7f44b.text: 「The machine can't keep up with my reactions?」
battle:a1f4c8a4bfc7f44b.notes: Independent proof: Machine failing to keep up with my reactions is a natural reading of 機体が反応に追いつけない in the surrounding pilot damage reactions. No named pilot or speed/ability value is inserted.

battle:5d3229b9bae82285.text: 「Do you want to make me angry?」

battle:4434fe77299f48c5.text: 「This machine has its limits, I suppose.」

battle:4ac9945f40481458.text: 「This murderous intent... Like a blade of ice.」

battle:4b381b7294553eab.text: 「This is as far as I go...」

battle:73b3feaa8658bb16.text: 「I still... have no intention of dying...」

battle:2f1eb2d2809e90d2.text: 「Don't screw with me... Don't screw with me!」

battle:6112aec606596805.text: 「I'll let you taste it, too...!\nThis thing called hell!」

battle:8a5705c22d3eca6a.text: 「I'll show you...! My power... my rage!」

battle:10a6571a90a09b86.text: 「I'll give vent to the $$ジェミナイド$$s' rage!」
battle:10a6571a90a09b86.notes: Geminaids follows local nondialogue; exact glossary key pending. Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:8de8ea74ed418398.text: 「My body's about to boil over with rage...!」

battle:e20fa00f01b2695f.text: 「$$ジェミニア$$, we're gonna crush them!\nUtterly and completely!」

battle:338abcadddf82b1c.text: 「...But, you know,\nthere's nothing I can do, either...!」

battle:4dbfb1106d97d9d5.text: 「This is the only thing I can do!」

battle:1cf89e135d0c74f8.text: 「Not yet! Don't think that was the end!」

battle:6af8b9fc09ddde5f.text: 「Either my rage subsides, or you die!\nOne or the other!」

battle:3f7462a0a7df812b.text: 「You just won't die!\nThis time I'll send you to the afterlife!」

battle:d113d659c73da75c.text: 「I'll put an end to Earthlings' history!\nI won't let you interfere!」

battle:ad6f3fc54ba60674.notes: Meaning proof: 破壊のためのエネルギーが満ちる says energy builds/fills, with no stated container. Fills me assigns it specifically to the pilot; nearby Sphere/Geminia attack calls do not establish that rather than the weapon/machine. Neutral wording retains the charge-up meaning.

battle:0464eac372541ab0.text: 「I'll hit you with my rage itself!」

battle:09f4fccbec828009.notes: Meaning proof: 喰らい尽くせ emphasizes devouring completely. Devour them all instead specifies all opponents/targets, a scope not supplied in the Japanese. Completely preserves the completion meaning without adding target count.

battle:6cea7aa447372020.text: 「$$フォルメニア$$! Cut down my enemies!」
battle:6cea7aa447372020.notes: Formenia short name follows local Formenia Light Blade; exact glossary key pending. Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:4faf7f107c0de4e6.text: 「I'll pour the $$スフィア$$'s power into this!」

battle:1473f49ac269369d.notes: Formenia short name follows local Formenia Light Blade; exact glossary key pending. Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:a9241f19b1571ddb.text: 「I'll make a blade of the $$ジェミナイド$$s' anguish!」
battle:a9241f19b1571ddb.notes: Geminaids follows local nondialogue; exact glossary key pending. Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:bc61c5d74f027d24.text: 「$$ジェミニア$$! Turn my rage into power!」

battle:544763bd0a668c20.text: 「$$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$...!\nYour power!」
battle:544763bd0a668c20.notes: The Feuding Twins follows current exact source non-dialogue label; older prose says Quarreling Twins. Root resolving glossary key. Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:e712a45e3515aa4b.text: 「I'll hit you with my rage itself!」

battle:45aab0061d1d3df8.notes: Light Particle Full Burst is direct attack-name rendering, root asked to confirm. Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:bf53b5b7a295b855.text: 「If you think you can escape, you're dead wrong!」

battle:2a44b33d6092a03e.text: 「You're not getting away, no matter how you try!」

battle:4aacb761eb7a2440.text: 「You think you're the only one who'll survive?!」
battle:4aacb761eb7a2440.notes: Independent proof: 自分だけは助かる is the reproach that the opponent expects personal survival/exemption. Current only-one-who-survives wording is idiomatic; no named third party or particular casualties added.

battle:84faa952fab5b3d8.text: 「Don't think paying you back double will be enough!」

battle:e1fe2e2254ac092b.text: 「If you're not running, you must want to die!」

battle:f93c4df9ab0440d4.text: 「You'll pay with your life\nfor making me angry!」

battle:c8a44287bb2ee56e.text: 「Don't think you can beat me one on one!」

battle:a6639d53bc7c83a5.text: 「Sneaking around, running away!\nIs that all you're capable of?!」

battle:51e4bfd9f07a26f0.text: 「You underestimate me!\nYou think that means you'll survive?!」

battle:b6a371d7dad21398.text: 「What's wrong, $$ジェミニア$$?!\nWhy can't you counterattack?!」

battle:b47740ff1a054b4b.text: 「Where the hell are you aiming, amateur?!」

battle:d5c6da13cb1d0136.text: 「How could an idiotic attack like that hit me?!」

battle:8f0a5b3d921ffb7e.text: 「How's that? Scared, aren't you? You incompetent fool!」

battle:ab92c52c19c04c92.text: 「I'm not the $$ジェミニス$$ captain\nfor nothing!」

battle:474c390a8eba157c.text: 「Think you can keep up with my psychokinetic piloting?!」

battle:705e7d1e14f4aeb3.text: 「Get it through your head: it's useless!」

battle:e276c0692014be87.text: 「If you're coming at me, give it everything you've got! Come on!」

battle:451eb504e8fd2e93.text: 「Don't think one hit means you'll win!」

battle:a2744f8dadb0974d.text: 「Like I'd flinch at a lackey's attack!」

battle:35825d04470c229d.text: 「If you want to fight me, put your life on the line!」

battle:403ccd7b5f044d4b.text: 「Like that could penetrate\n$$ジェミニア$$'s armor!」

battle:6d170443d94f6ade.text: 「Someone that weak\ncould never protect the planet they were born on!」

battle:333ceaf74de6579d.text: 「Tch! You're just an ordinary opponent after all!」
battle:333ceaf74de6579d.notes: Colloquial 並の相手じゃねえか can be read as an ordinary-opponent rhetorical assertion or a negative not-ordinary remark. Escalating damage context supports drafted no ordinary opponent; independent review requested. Meaning proof: 並の相手じゃねえか is normally the colloquial affirmative rhetorical construction 'aren't you just an ordinary opponent'. Current 'no ordinary opponent' reverses it. Nearby1039 calls the enemy weak,1042/1043 dismiss its attacks, supporting the derisive surface reading. Keep review status because voice intonation or a source typo could complicate the reading. Independent proof: Voice/cue and source-typo possibility remain unresolved. Source text is immutable; report uses its normal grammatical reading with nearby weak-attack taunts, not an inferred correction to Japanese.

battle:91e0927776c320a6.text: 「Like that would work on me now!」

battle:50014781f09a0165.text: 「You think this little damage\ncan stop $$ジェミニア$$ as it is now?!」

battle:b9fb2641ec717544.text: 「You bastard...!\nDo you want to anger me that badly?!」

battle:6f96248ea1336e6d.text: 「I can't worry about wounds!\nNot until I've crushed them!」

battle:cd19a7ff6b059381.text: 「Ha! Looks like I can finally get serious!」

battle:b098c1c78f6b102d.text: 「As long as I've got my $$スフィア$$,\nthese wounds are nothing!」

battle:8ccb38c875037b2d.text: 「It's been a long time since I've been this fired up!」

battle:0a689be7ee469937.text: 「This little damage\nonly makes my $$スフィア$$ stronger!」

battle:f04537f2541bfc2f.text: 「Damn... damn it! What kind of joke is this?!」

battle:811d55b3c4b156dd.text: 「Don't think you've won over this,\nyou ignorant yokel from the fringe!」

battle:1931e024713220a7.text: 「I can see why\nyou caught their eye!」

battle:869d870edd3d9b86.text: 「$$ジェミニア$$ will keep fighting\nuntil I breathe my last!」

battle:b13b6094ce6c00c6.text: 「Hahahahaha!\nI can't stop the laughter welling up!」

battle:13b0d940f67f60e3.text: 「Like I can even feel pain right now!」

battle:285e047cc02f95b6.text: 「This power...! What the hell is it?!」

battle:38e369f7fa6ac1fe.text: 「Could this one be...!\nA $$スフィア・リアクター$$?!」

battle:38207c6741a49c04.text: 「Like hell I'll die!\nI've still got my $$スフィア$$!!」

battle:ede7d5ef04374d7c.text: 「So long, new $$リアクター$$ who inherited the curse! Your mommy's beckoning to you from hell!」

battle:26ef2201c1265d6f.text: 「My name is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$.\nI command the resistance suppression force!」

battle:465fc2f5139423e6.text: 「Then let me play your funeral march!」

battle:f3bc3492da5eef68.text: 「I will make you understand your powerlessness!」

battle:e02125dde91a3e56.text: 「I will teach you the terror of $$サイデリアル$$!」

battle:29b7d5ecfe1c2367.text: 「I will give you overwhelming despair and fear!」

battle:cd2212b189bf8abd.text: 「I will make you regret being born!」

battle:b38215a4c4e5cd06.text: 「To think you came all this way to die!」

battle:1879434ff3cffdf8.text: 「To defy me, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!」

battle:8ba447c5e3bceb9d.text: 「You will taste how terrifying I am!」

battle:e3590ce05a0115cc.text: 「Prey should behave like prey\nand submit quietly to the hunt!」

battle:fe4b6e20222d239e.text: 「I hope you are an opponent worthy of my skill!」

battle:863bbe0e5a4ba97d.text: 「You have already fallen into my scheme!」

battle:df10ddddfaf0ace4.text: 「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$, coming forth!」
battle:df10ddddfaf0ace4.notes: Source surname starts hiragana べ (ギルター・べローネ) unlike standard katakana ベ. Same explicit speaker, so canonical full-name reference used.

battle:74666f47f3df43a6.text: 「Those who oppose me will be punished with death!」

battle:e5750cc5fa030147.text: 「You, too, will taste the poison that is me!」

battle:d2d3469335e4596c.text: 「This is a machine worthy of me!」

battle:f1198738a4004a2b.text: 「$$シャウラス・リーダー$$... What a fine sound!」

battle:d7158f523cd7418d.text: 「You are persistent, but this ends here!」

battle:4a7abb77ae009584.text: 「$$セツコ・オハラ$$! Come to me.」

battle:4f5c750bc1fde085.text: 「$$悲しみの乙女$$! Your very existence is dangerous!」

battle:59e85461f7971e51.text: 「You are insufferably overbearing, $$傷だらけの獅子$$!」
battle:59e85461f7971e51.notes: Independent proof: 暑苦しい carries Rand's excessive hot-blooded presence and possible heat wordplay. Insufferably overbearing captures the hostile complaint; no meaning rewrite solely to restore a preferred joke.

battle:4e3383c0f648c4cd.text: 「$$揺れる天秤$$! This is the end!」

battle:e5ccba2d7182d1fa.text: 「Your composure ends here,\n$$クロウ・ブルースト$$!」

battle:c41629860dd6dc36.text: 「That is as far as you go, $$いがみ合う双子$$!」
battle:c41629860dd6dc36.notes: Feuding Twins follows current source label, exact glossary key pending. Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:298e739bf44cf6ef.text: 「An immature $$リアクター$$ is no match for me!」

battle:b5bb7cdc261ad27a.text: 「You worthless nobody! You would defy me?!」

battle:735ebedf7393edc3.text: 「A fine opportunity! I will finish you here!」

battle:849248ae8a80fecb.text: 「You have given me a fine chance to shine!」

battle:f1bf050e18d066c2.text: 「Leave this\nto me, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!」

battle:72ae536653841835.text: 「You useless fool...!\nDo not trouble me with this!」

battle:5894d22ecb227cab.text: 「I will protect Lord $$バルビエル$$ at any cost!」

battle:7c9e5f0aaff24cd1.text: 「Damn you! Using your superior as a shield?!」

battle:3696b4affbbe6557.text: 「Your misfortune was having me as your opponent!」

battle:979cb53bf569a28a.text: 「The time has come to show my true ability!」

battle:f995a56530a12c6b.text: 「To think I am made to clear the way...!」

battle:37fe2c03617b3918.text: 「Thank your god\nfor letting you survive a little longer.」

battle:4a4e56ecd533db53.text: 「Wha...! What do you mean, I cannot attack?!」

battle:d946b828e42b6542.text: 「I have fallen into the enemy's trap...?!」

battle:b4978193b0fe9fa1.text: 「Look up 'not knowing your place'\nin the dictionary!」
battle:b4978193b0fe9fa1.notes: Resolved to newly approved glossary references during final proposal validation.

battle:78fadc4610cda5f7.text: 「It is not that you are weak. I am simply strong!」

battle:8876454e728e02ee.text: 「I can almost hear a defeated dog's howling!」

battle:0236617152fb16a2.text: 「Go back\nand relearn the very basics of tactics!」

battle:a27c0788b8e66386.text: 「Frustrated? Of course you are! Of course!」

battle:ab94f58f9402bb70.text: 「Even a $$スフィア・リアクター$$\ncan do no more than this?!」

battle:050cc419cf6c665c.text: 「You do not seem to have\nmastered your $$スフィア$$!」

battle:d597be3e4c91bea6.text: 「This is $$サイデリアル$$'s technological prowess!」

battle:083ea8c40b77f63e.text: 「Hehehe... How sad, if that is your full strength.」

battle:27ae154756bd4d4e.text: 「Engaging you is a waste of effort.」

battle:0463221b450976b5.text: 「This is all the galactic fringe's forces amount to.」

battle:13c6674dc5e42abc.text: 「There is no need even to invite you\ninto $$サイデリアル$$'s ranks.」

battle:982fc124b4442b22.text: 「An irritating small fry getting carried away...!」

battle:10b925fa7af5f3af.text: 「Was that supposed to be an attack? Hm?!」

battle:93fcd2ad1978899f.text: 「Damn you!\nDamaging $$シャウラス・リーダー$$!」

battle:200bef104db0f403.text: 「How dare you!\nYou have damaged this proud Leader!」

battle:b567e6da85be7a17.text: 「Damn you!\nOutwitting me, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$!」

battle:4e8ad5cf58c2d798.text: 「This is bad...!\nAt this rate my plan will be ruined!」

battle:e17d201049c8b173.text: 「How long will you persist in this futile resistance?!」

battle:adbd510f0a021b97.text: 「A cornered rat will bite a cat, as they say...!」

battle:df8b2be4836fb30a.text: 「Such a warrior, on a planet on the fringe...!」

battle:8f7d35947d143666.text: 「That power will bring calamity to $$サイデリアル$$...!」

battle:72f1049ca4e376d3.text: 「Our escape route is already cut off!\nWe have no choice but to fight!」

battle:0e43d63f2600da39.text: 「Do you intend to humiliate me, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$?!」

battle:3f7a68a148c4e620.text: 「Unforgivable...! I will never forgive you! Never!」

battle:8d460e1785bcdb1a.text: 「This humiliation...!\nI will make you taste it, too!」

battle:a3a7e766399efd35.text: 「If I were only in perfect condition,\nthis would never...!」
battle:a3a7e766399efd35.notes: Independent proof: コンディション does not explicitly identify pilot versus machine condition. Draft first-person excuse is plausible for Gilter but voice/consumer context would be needed to prove it; no particular injury or malfunction invented.

battle:fc15fa10a2445434.text: 「My plan should have been perfect!\nWhy has this happened?!」

battle:86650130f3d4949b.text: 「You truly deserve\nto be called $$ザ・クラッシャー$$!」

battle:3240ca0831980328.text: 「Shut that insolent mouth,\n$$クロウ・ブルースト$$!」

battle:d096568e9549add1.text: 「So this is a $$スフィア・リアクター$$'s power...!」

battle:5c752d325d4fcbf2.text: 「That will, that power... is driving me into a corner!」

battle:01700a2f68cd537c.text: 「Damn you, $$サルディアス$$!\nYou, of all people...!」

battle:4ccbd0d9cc14ef3b.text: 「T-this is bad!\nI am being utterly outpaced!」

battle:bbde005f2cf91fef.text: 「Was it a mistake to underestimate such a small foe?!」

battle:e001e11fb23f4b13.text: 「I-I will not die...!\nI refuse to die!」

battle:f802be2e710e53c2.text: 「Damn it, next time! Next time, I will...!」

battle:c207728771e73e53.text: 「For me, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$,\nto fall in a place like this...!」

battle:f716b22d241b99c8.text: 「N-no...!\nI cannot lose $$シャウラス・リーダー$$...!」

battle:9847172743e0e857.text: 「Let us see\nwhose strategy is superior, yours or mine!」

battle:33acc10bd924f9b9.text: 「Your skill truly makes you\na worthy opponent for me!」

battle:bf0c16d671cb77e8.text: 「Taking down the carrier\nhas been a basic tactic since ancient times!」

battle:7f12026f7173cf10.text: 「Even your vaunted speed\nlooks motionless to my eyes!」

battle:12316a0655906313.text: 「This will wear away your body and mind!」
battle:12316a0655906313.notes: Independent proof: 心身 explicitly includes both body and mind here. Kept both effects, unlike earlier poison lines that only named pilot and machine; no cross-line homogenization.

battle:d6901c9b22cdc736.text: 「I will sink you into a sea of poison!」

battle:47063132d6aab4ee.text: 「The scorpion's poison will eat away your life!」

battle:ab12c9900fa9a006.text: 「I will show you $$シャウラス$$'s power!」

battle:34628f51e057b160.text: 「I will shatter you along with your will to resist!」

battle:03d0bef3176be644.text: 「The scorpion's tail will pierce your life!」

battle:9a1537dd30fd9c43.text: 「I will drive you into a corner!」

battle:31525897a52d04a2.text: 「The poisoned needle that is me will pierce your heart!」

battle:3ca913d5512d24fb.text: 「Our poison will kill any hero, no matter who!」

battle:fcf30f1ed769d23f.text: 「Open all gunports! Fire a full salvo!」

battle:7ce587a5fd4cfdd3.text: 「All gun crews, aim carefully! Do not miss!」

battle:53e972c3d3ac010d.text: 「Do not let them escape! Make certain they die!」

battle:f562a270ab48da3a.text: 「Teach them the price of challenging this ship!」

battle:421cdc2f0c12d948.text: 「You do not even realize you were lured out!」

battle:cfd1d644614c8726.text: 「I have already planned\nthe entire sequence through the counterattack!」

battle:f784cc40745b74d8.text: 「Now it is our turn to corner you!」

battle:9d4a5214c7462b8b.text: 「You have already wandered\ninto a maze with no exit!」

battle:d2ae3f29f516fe01.text: 「I will teach you that you are the prey!」

battle:cf32d0a6a805352d.text: 「An attack is followed by a counterattack...\nSelf-evident, is it not?!」

battle:7e6fe837442ee62a.text: 「I can...! I can do it, too!」

battle:c74a2339566a8684.text: 「You were making a fool of me, too!」

battle:102e4cbd7825fe8f.text: 「If the world rejects me, then I'll...!」

battle:ae58d25d572cdd3c.text: 「Do you intend to deny my existence, too?!」

battle:bb39fa01a6098736.text: 「Don't think you can defeat\nthe $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$アン・アーレス$$!」

battle:740019353dea5134.text: 「I'll hunt you to the ends of hell!」

battle:b87ef135daed0478.text: 「$$悲しみの乙女$$!\nYour existence cannot be allowed!」

battle:03fe8c0c0d9c8b01.text: 「$$セツコ・オハラ$$!\nYou were laughing at me behind my back, too!」

battle:a894db4ddedafc0d.text: 「I hate you for living with the one you love...!」
battle:a894db4ddedafc0d.notes: Independent proof: Source says living with the beloved, not marriage. English kept without adding spouse, legal relationship, or gender.

battle:84d1e3937c8ba658.text: 「$$ザ・クラッシャー$$!\nUnleash your anger and hatred, too!」

battle:79a7d50221f7c712.text: 「If I can't have you, then I'll...!」

battle:ad0fc76f44287de4.text: 「I'll twist that smug face of yours!」

battle:f26188a52943ceeb.text: 「$$アドヴェント$$!\nYour very existence makes me miserable!」

battle:74be936f0fc771c3.text: 「Don't think you'll get away with this!」

battle:331c1ef40901b291.text: 「Do you want to taste the scorpion's poison that badly?!」

battle:7747e8e83e97087f.text: 「Caught you! I won't let you go now!」

battle:6ad674395e230fcc.text: 「Are you that determined to reject me?!」

battle:0eac967013f7a319.text: 「Are you making a fool of me again like that?!」

battle:50d3d6d9568d4692.text: 「Where...?! Where did you disappear to?!\nAnswer me!」

battle:f6316d339fa2041d.text: 「You won't hit me...!\nYou won't hit me, you won't hit me!」

battle:3f429cec8ab3aff8.text: 「Don't think being beautiful means you'll win!」

battle:ebbd80bd145dc3e7.text: 「Even your vaunted power\nwon't work on me now!」

battle:64b40bfc68767346.text: 「How much do you have to mock me before you're satisfied?!」

battle:3354a06f9769a876.text: 「Are you saying I'm not worth\nfighting seriously?!」

battle:f3a41cd264dc2795.text: 「Aah! My guts are twisting apart with rage!」

battle:065ac5a477f0ee1a.text: 「How could I leave this grudge unavenged...?!」

battle:ff35ac572903d34d.text: 「Hatred burns through me!\nUntil I kill you with my own hands!」

battle:af9605f69dc45aee.text: 「I hate you...! Hate you, hate you, hate you, hate you!」

battle:50f6fedf2ff3500a.text: 「It hurts...! It hurts, it hurts, it hurts, it hurts!」

battle:7222a9cde97b01d4.text: 「I-I have to kill that one quickly,\nor this hatred will tear my body apart!」

battle:b76fb0663513d9a7.text: 「Aaaaah... My head hurts! My chest hurts!」

battle:81c5b4b532b7adb4.text: 「Why can't I win?!\nI'm piloting $$アン・アーレス$$!!」

battle:c865b4b1776ba434.text: 「$$スフィア$$!\nDrain my life! Absorb my hatred!!」

battle:c265c59f3fc0bf4e.text: 「So this is the true power of a $$スフィア$$...!」
battle:c265c59f3fc0bf4e.notes: Meaning proof: 真のスフィアの力 describes the Sphere's true power here. A true Sphere's power instead qualifies the Sphere itself as genuine, implying a real/false Sphere distinction. Local An-Arles library context f370be9713247834 establishes Clavier uses the actual Sphere as a temporary pilot and its true Reactor draws out greater power; it does not call her Sphere false. Attach true to power. Independent proof: Modifier attachment checked against library:f370be9713247834: An-Arles carries the Resentful Scorpion Sphere, Clavier temporary pilot, Barbiel true Reactor with greater output. This context supports true power, not a different category of true Sphere.

battle:a8072fd042f3af4e.text: 「A $$スフィア$$...! Ah, what I've always longed for!」

battle:009610bb7c7a0a09.text: 「Can't I win?!\nAs a woman or as a warrior?!」

battle:30c17e71677460c8.text: 「Why can't I beat\nsuch a barbaric man?!」

battle:70321dcab8a94f35.text: 「Flesh, bones, and soul... I'll cut through them all!」

battle:c8af634b227d18cb.text: 「$$アン・アーレス$$!\nFeed on my hatred!」

battle:b6773af5f8da662d.text: 「The poison in my heart will engulf you!」

battle:a0241a66ade51476.text: 「The $$スフィア$$s! Every one of them will be mine!」
battle:a0241a66ade51476.notes: Independent proof: スフィア！その全てが私のものに can mean every Sphere or the entirety of the addressed Sphere's power. Current plural is plausible, but local An-Arles/Sphere attack sequence alone does not settle the scope; preserve for contextual review.

battle:ce0da1325ce502fb.text: 「$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$! Drink in my life!」

battle:adbd1ed2f967aea2.text: 「That's it! Engulf my enemies in poison!」

battle:d709e616ccddce31.text: 「I have to make sure they don't abandon me...!」

battle:d0e4640a0158381d.text: 「Even a nobody like me can do this much...!」

battle:ad7bba455f0260e1.text: 「I'm actually pretty confident\nin my piloting skills!」

battle:62efb5029d0b1b0b.text: 「When it counts, I can get things done too!」

battle:a81bd2935aa94ef4.text: 「I'll give research, my personal life, and fighting my all!」

battle:19807cd70cffd134.text: 「As long as $$クロウ$$ and everyone are with me...!」

battle:092f41484aa15a24.text: 「If I keep trying, I'm sure a way will open up!」

battle:9ee649effff5dc1d.text: 「I won't lose, run away, or be afraid!」

battle:0747383da28ea775.text: 「I'll show you I can fight up close too!」

battle:f929c75500aca1cf.text: 「Looking at that person makes my heart wither...!」

battle:f0c3739ceb350e0a.text: 「This might be...\na good chance to learn about the $$スフィア$$s' power!」

battle:f8b638c0a57dddf3.text: 「I'll test the $$スフィア$$'s power! Even if I'm scared...」

battle:7cc280e1cc6524df.text: 「H-He's the kind of man I can't stand!」

battle:334ce03545745edd.text: 「Something about these people... gives me the creeps...!」

battle:9e56412fffed1f14.text: 「If I just take it, they'll target me again...!」

battle:1d535757f805e6cd.text: 「I-It's not fair if I'm the only one getting hurt!」

battle:059f125366d9c093.text: 「I have to attack before they pull out...!」

battle:4da4e6ef7f2ea5b2.text: 「You can't just hit me and run away!」

battle:0da517116f8fa935.text: 「I'll show you I can be useful too!」

battle:1d5aaab4acce654c.text: 「$$ブルー$$ made an opening for me...!」

battle:cd043bcf29ce1659.text: 「Please take this seriously,\n$$サルディアス$$!」

battle:9dad2f45db387fe4.text: 「This is about all I can do!」

battle:35a230749479f0a1.text: 「You'll fix me up afterward, right, $$ランド$$?」

battle:f1574db337e0988e.text: 「I'll show you I can handle a one-on-one fight...!」

battle:5fd66762b8225c1f.text: 「I'm supposed to aim for that enemy, right?」

battle:519142db004c8f54.text: 「I have to draw the enemy over here...!」

battle:aad087e8df2afb00.text: 「I have to at least do what I've been entrusted with!」

battle:5ad9fb687f75588d.text: 「I'll leave the finishing blow to you!」

battle:68f2326af4185e80.text: 「I can at least hold them in place!」

battle:821a735b74c999f0.text: 「Oh...\nHow could I mess up at a time like this...!」

battle:752d0ae6404699e3.text: 「C-Could it be... the enemy's just toying with me?」

battle:7512e86d721bec5c.text: 「I-I can't let this go on!\nI've got to move!」

battle:e94c193ddcb9c90f.text: 「I won't let anyone call me a nobody again!」

battle:dc137675e60510cd.text: 「I want to give myself a pat on the back!」

battle:fce377a2b269cf62.text: 「Even a lowly underling can do this much...!」

battle:c27b14e087b03e31.text: 「If I stay calm, I can do this too!」

battle:d590304682d13dbf.text: 「As long as I'm not looking down, I can see the attacks!」

battle:a1f0b6a7300ff2d9.text: 「The $$スフィア$$'s power\ncan't be this weak...!」

battle:f5ee4fd2aa3e6df1.text: 「You haven't used the $$スフィア$$'s power yet...!」

battle:cbb2240f7e66a17d.text: 「Oh, honestly! I got scared for nothing!」

battle:1abc5a8969bc1c98.text: 「How dare you do that to the $$エイクロス$$ I serviced...!」

battle:cdbe008741bac147.text: 「I got left and right mixed up...」

battle:53074cbd95c3d5d9.text: 「Oh, honestly...!\nI can't believe I messed up at a time like this...!」

battle:f6d3ca4d36a17d30.text: 「I should still be able to turn this around!」

battle:708eb6dfd45612b7.text: 「Oh, oh no...\nI'm getting backed further into a corner...!」

battle:5264509284eda764.text: 「If the same spot gets hit again,\nit won't hold...!」

battle:bbcef616e956845a.text: 「D-Deep breaths at a time like this!」

battle:0355b24874cb7493.text: 「S-Stay calm...!\nI have to calm down and think of a solution!」

battle:19f502bf51075c8f.text: 「I decided I'd survive,\nso I've got to do this...!」

battle:6d01ba19e3c9a2d9.text: 「I-If I keep looking down,\nI'll miss my last chance...!」

battle:507e083b2a27008b.text: 「It's times like these when you say, "So what!"\n...Right, $$クロウ$$?」

battle:d23c71ce8c5c744a.text: 「So this is the true power of someone who wields a $$スフィア$$...!」

battle:0a61edb30917bd49.text: 「I-I can't take any more! I'm sorry!」

battle:e41dbadd2a62ff99.text: 「Wah! Y-You want me\nto greet all the players!?」

battle:86e93d3f611f713f.text: 「U-Um... Well... I'm not really sure what to say at a time like this...」

battle:add577bb9e204c5e.text: 「Please enjoy the main game, Tengoku-hen, too!」

battle:2794264e639822aa.text: 「...Though I don't know whether I'll be in it...」

battle:0a53c24cdf63358c.text: 「This is a good time to make my move...!」

battle:f7c32fc800edd98f.text: 「I can see the road to victory...!」

battle:fed239d798d9a0b9.text: 「This is gonna be a big play!」

battle:be8e6db25a86106f.text: 「Hail Mary! Time to go for it!」

battle:4f7007e421467c8d.text: 「Sorry, but this is my job too...!」

battle:5c8fc3397355f3cd.text: 「Go ahead and hate me if you want.」

battle:3d432e62f5bbd240.text: 「These are the only things\nI've gotten good at...!」

battle:d7e9db2182bf9d62.text: 「I'll throw in a little extra for once!」

battle:f915665778b118c1.text: 「I'm done testing you! Here's the real thing!」

battle:8d085c4c29bb072a.text: 「A world this dangerous isn't my idea of a good time...!」

battle:2d96c04dc2cab44d.text: 「Your very existence gets a "no thanks" from me!」

battle:080d90241ad06f21.text: 「Time for you to leave Earth, pronto!」

battle:4b4e528fc9a2be56.text: 「I've seen more than enough of how the military does things!」

battle:07d6325a51a51c41.text: 「Those textbook\ncombat patterns won't work on me!」

battle:3a54a418f33c88b7.text: 「I've never been any good\nat dealing with women, but...!」

battle:e7079142d4cf1abd.text: 「At this range, it's time for this!」

battle:3423a1bcd9eaff4a.text: 「$$アサルトコンバットパターン・ファイズ$$\n...!」

battle:8756591763fb88c1.text: 「Tch... It's almost absurd how well this tactic works.」

battle:ef03e838183e89f6.text: 「Finish by punching right through the middle!」

battle:d1201bbff6d04e13.text: 「I pay back what I owe right away!」

battle:5d1410bf13077d0e.text: 「Taking a beating without fighting back isn't my style...!」

battle:4562bafc5b4f8189.text: 「I don't forget a grudge or a favor...!」

battle:c471244ff892cc7c.text: 「Hold on! Let me have a turn too!」

battle:4a986a2cfdeec1d8.text: 「For my friends, I'll do it for free!」

battle:5c47d86dd592846d.text: 「All right, this is where I come in!」

battle:e5697727d64a61ea.text: 「Putting on a brave face is my style too...!」

battle:c8de9d97d776e3ed.text: 「Anything I say would just sound like sour grapes...!」

battle:51ffa506eea1cb44.text: 「You got me...\nGuess I'll give credit where it's due.」

battle:8d682cffc5da41fe.text: 「Out of energy...!\nWhat am I, a complete amateur!?」

battle:ebe3ba4c62d86a99.text: 「Misjudging the range like that...\nI'm losing my touch!」

battle:8a9e6cf22ed169fd.text: 「Of all the stratagems, retreat is best...!\nTime to get moving!」

battle:318d925dac74841e.text: 「I'm pretty confident in my getaway skills.」

battle:798846d6f0b0f849.text: 「I'm not a fan of pointless scrambling.」

battle:57a91120e6f20654.text: 「I don't like other people touching me.」

battle:2a28ac7f2cfe8ce7.text: 「Heh... That's another one of my talents.」

battle:03d76e9339cc02dd.text: 「Heh... My wild guess was right on the money.」

battle:4aa9d5ef995b9c79.text: 「A takeaway. Got one over on you.」

battle:9c8726ccca5f8bf1.text: 「I'll win without a scratch and save some money!」

battle:72d68ccca1cd683b.text: 「Not good. That's a waste of energy.」

battle:176dbb43dda374e2.text: 「I wish the Chief would make me\nsome gear like this too...」

battle:6f9c46e8132300d9.text: 「And I wanted to win without a scratch.」

battle:e66352c5952d06c5.text: 「So that's your play. Gave me quite a surprise.」

battle:267b9511736ba1c9.text: 「A scratch is still a wound, I guess...!」

battle:93145e9884294224.text: 「Tch... Scratched my lovely skin, did you...!」

battle:8f44314440e3d7e6.text: 「Not good.\nMy predictions are starting to miss the mark.」

battle:8dfc501dff134817.text: 「Little things add up, as they say.\nBetter watch it.」

battle:5f3676b641401a85.text: 「Good grief, that's a little too rude.」

battle:876ff54df4ab25e4.text: 「That's a problem. I'm no good with rough stuff.」

battle:ed33a6ca229ea1c6.text: 「I might've picked a fight with the wrong one...」

battle:688d72f8f6aef218.text: 「When things get dangerous,\nthat's when you sharpen your senses...!」

battle:00d2fa5f942a8249.text: 「Whoa, this isn't the time to get cocky...!」

battle:2c8fa5147f336936.text: 「Tch...! Have I been playing too nicely!?」

battle:2fc2ea5edbd05227.text: 「Oh, no!\nThe repair bill is shooting up!」

battle:5c464c38c2d8b76d.text: 「Not good...! I might die for the first time!」

battle:ec139817d799d433.text: 「So what! I've still got some fight in me!」

battle:a34e8564303f73e1.text: 「A pro never gives up\nuntil the very last moment...!」

battle:2cc0f6ef6efe6165.text: 「The autobalancer's shot...!\nI'll take manual control from here!」

battle:74c1361bbdb8bf23.text: 「It's too soon to go rafting\non the River of the Dead!」

battle:cf1b02250e9f0500.text: 「Maybe it's time\nto pay for my sins...!」

battle:f6ad75eb899d7a8a.text: 「Good grief...\nWait, this isn't the time for that!」

battle:4f62c558edb8aa6c.text: 「Hey... Nice work. Let's call it a day.」

battle:c27968429e5ebb84.text: 「Now, I've got a little proposition... Think you could divert some of the mech upgrade budget to me personally?」

battle:c0ed59346439a771.text: 「The Chief says the data I've been bringing in lately isn't good enough. It's really hurting my performance reviews.」

battle:8350fd86df34da4a.text: 「What? You can't use the whole force's funds for that? ...Fair point.」

battle:bee77c04bdbed5c0.text: 「Then let me strut my stuff next time you play. I'm counting on you, partner.」

battle:3fe8f486631942d7.text: 「Sorry, I'll be racking up the points!」

battle:0705eae406ee4150.text: 「I'll take the glory for once too!」

battle:9a2ebbf9bf4a38d4.text: 「This is always my job, isn't it...」

battle:a5b16a8453399add.text: 「I've really grown into the short-straw role!」

battle:06795c94a01e5f0e.text: 「This frustration... It's like the hell of being in debt.」

battle:546fb7d76a86e37e.text: 「Cowards are the ones who survive on the battlefield.」

battle:9276ac5338db947c.text: 「When my hunches are right, nobody can beat me.」

battle:806ec0dcaef42833.text: 「Hm? Is the wind starting to change...?」

battle:51f7b29369334cd6.text: 「Even a tiny scratch does major damage to my wallet!」

battle:7b955b7c79dee0d9.text: 「Little by little, something's starting to go wrong...」

battle:02d2d8ddb48e8e4f.text: 「Tch! They've got my tactical patterns figured out!」

battle:30b5b06ecb030fcc.text: 「Do you even get it!?\nI'm the one paying for repairs!」

battle:c35bb87915674eed.text: 「Not good...\nI can't shake this bad feeling.」

battle:432c5e7bff5f1cc2.text: 「A dramatic comeback from the brink\nreally isn't my style...!」

battle:9056dcc2c007943d.text: 「Damn!\nDying to wipe out my debt would be way too pathetic!」

battle:087045376a181742.text: 「Once I've decided, I head straight for it...!」

battle:2af66a2cf8ea08b1.text: 「There's no time to hesitate on the battlefield...!」

battle:9aed6641bb6cc036.text: 「If I've got time to worry, I've got time to advance...!」

battle:4e158aa54c523241.text: 「The debt never ends, and neither does the fighting...!\nWhat a life!」

battle:504ea6bbf6aafaad.text: 「The Chief built this machine too, after all!」

battle:cbabb839d8cb69eb.text: 「While I was at it,\nI should've asked for a different color...」

battle:1bd271a1597d7d2d.text: 「Just what I'd expect from the Chief.\nTuned exactly how I like it...!」

battle:d054db77cbbdde9c.text: 「Well... I'm counting on you again, partner!」

battle:27a6382fc57c32b0.text: 「This is a new $$ブラスタ$$,\ncarrying on the spirit of R and B!」

battle:80bfbf88cb2be4ec.text: 「At this rate, I'll be completely broke...!」

battle:dd0a0bd5179a22d7.text: 「If I don't find work,\nI can forget about paying off my debts...!」

battle:b6685e182fdc6ec4.text: 「Now then...\nHow much pay can I expect...?」

battle:849245530db1ce68.text: 「I've got to show what a bargain I am...!」

battle:77982fd40fa44111.text: 「Believe it or not, I'm a persistent guy...!」

battle:9ebbe3a0a80c1ae7.text: 「Sorry... I don't want to die either...!」

battle:9d7e5da3966dc144.text: 「We know each other's tricks inside out!\nNo need to hold back!」

battle:92f7ab136360eceb.text: 「Even a mighty dam can fall to an ant, or however it goes...!」

battle:e29485741aeb0b0b.text: 「This monster's off the charts!\nI'll focus on breaking through one point!」

battle:b99a310bf7cee55b.text: 「Hit the ship and break their formation!」

battle:881238dac27a66ba.text: 「You've hit rock bottom.\nI'll put an end to you!」

battle:7e0a612bee74301d.text: 「$$ファイヤバグ$$!\nI'll be there to see your end!」

battle:f7fe962e5e35ddbe.text: 「Give $$マリリン$$ my regards in the afterlife!」

battle:fdba83ccf83b3238.text: 「No mercy for traitors, $$サルディアス$$!」

battle:df4380cc31252c84.text: 「This isn't how I wanted it to end...!」

battle:760e57d83fc39f34.text: 「$$クラヴィア$$! I'll stop you myself!」

battle:3fea7b8313cb1fa4.text: 「You shot at me, so you were ready\nto be shot back, right, $$ギルター$$?」

battle:3760c7f82a9d699d.text: 「Out of the way, $$尸刻$$!\nYou're not the one I'm after!」

battle:7ca6e7543c274826.text: 「I'm not so softhearted that I'd just\nhand what's mine over to someone else!」

battle:c59d66eeccbe3b49.text: 「I may be outmatched as a $$リアクター$$,\nbut I don't intend to lose this fight!」

battle:8f5f91258bcc06ef.text: 「We've both been chosen\nby something troublesome, huh...!」

battle:8c84fffebd726a50.text: 「$$尸空$$!\nI'll blast a hole in your void!」

battle:ce972810b7cc909e.text: 「The dislike is mutual!\nLet's go all out, $$尸空$$!」

battle:4fa95ed5fef7101c.text: 「At this range... I'll pull it off!」

battle:5ff20ddfd858d140.text: 「I'll show you I can do it with this too!」

battle:df5630dc7dc3bd85.text: 「Here goes,\n$$アサルトコンバットパターン・ファイズ$$!」

battle:62c55fd83f09e419.text: 「A real man meets the challenge head-on!」

battle:050ca2fd3db9a713.text: 「It's still absurd how well this tactic works.」

battle:e031e2b121eebe33.text: 「Finish with a straight shot right down the middle!」

battle:a290b76fcf6c467f.text: 「Heh... That coin's making a nice sound.」

battle:09f41cb11a3a0559.text: 「Absurdly effective... and the best tactic there is.」

battle:d435118a66124992.text: 「I'll teach you that repayment is mandatory!」

battle:4a766b4d508de1ae.text: 「Pull back, then push...! Now's the time!」

battle:89c1140643a5c5b7.text: 「You'll have to keep me company a little longer!」

battle:ffb4b0de71f24208.text: 「Maybe I was born to play this role...」

battle:50a2205948f157fa.text: 「Let's get to picking them off one by one!」

battle:49d23818435af082.text: 「It's almost funny how little I can do...」

battle:eb74a21908336929.text: 「If I can't pay you back,\nI'll find a way. That's my policy!」

battle:2360eb6b2f6a4a26.text: 「I can dodge attacks, but debt still hits me...\nLife's tough...」

battle:ddd1fe25d64f4842.text: 「Dodge with as little movement as possible...!」

battle:4b818dc85083da4f.text: 「If this thing gets scratched,\nmy debt will probably grow.」

battle:b19e81ffd0542508.text: 「This really does feel right to me.」

battle:44d786cf49803df1.text: 「If I show off like this,\nmy signing bonus should go up.」

battle:5e39c02bc5483e92.text: 「These nimble moves will land me a job!」

battle:2c907cd3a301507e.text: 「That should make a good impression\non my future employer!」

battle:4efca37b1f762081.text: 「You're not as good with your $$スフィア$$\nas you make out either!」

battle:ff77ad93b24b499e.text: 「Close...! One wrong step and that would've hit dead-on...!」

battle:37bfada88dd19f3e.text: 「Somehow managed to dodge a direct hit...!」

battle:3233e94e236b0d9c.text: 「Looks like\nthat rhythm's a bad match for me.」

battle:ce830407d79aaac6.text: 「A cut above the opponents I've faced so far...!」

battle:dc7144b72194dd44.text: 「Been a while since I broke out in a cold sweat...」

battle:f2d17203d74428ac.text: 「Turn a crisis into an opportunity...\nSure would like to pull that off.」

battle:d771663dfeef12f2.text: 「Are you watching, folks?\nEven now, I'm not giving up!」

battle:49f842858cf2eb48.text: 「A chance to show off how tough I am too...!\nThat's how I'm choosing to see it!」

battle:9bb9fd0fb9c168ba.text: 「Not good!\nI'll never land a contract if I look pathetic!」

battle:a95d02ac4e88a41c.text: 「Compared to being unemployed and in debt,\nthis pain ain't worth a damn!」

battle:e550174f231140a0.text: 「Focus...!\nAs long as I'm alive, there's something I can do...!」

battle:eb32a54e9705d758.text: 「The first to panic are the first to die...\nThat's the battlefield...!」

battle:74c3a56abc5c5d4a.text: 「The repair bill's going into the red!」

battle:2d3307bec2615e3d.text: 「I'm prepared to die in the gutter,\nbut I'll be damned if I leave debt behind!」

battle:226a1d14bfef46d5.text: 「An enemy even the $$スコートＳＰ$$ can't shake off!?」

battle:7f93fbe5f924e1fd.text: 「This is where we hold our ground, $$スコートＳＰ$$!」

battle:a30128975e5a0de4.text: 「Sorry I'm such a pathetic partner,\n$$リ・ブラスタ$$...!」

battle:52130b21727578d0.text: 「I can't let them destroy\nthe Chief's masterpiece!」

battle:e078d590a78a81e1.text: 「Damn!\nI knew they were tough, but still!」

battle:299186c19d019767.text: 「I hate to admit it,\nbut you're better with your $$スフィア$$ than I am!」

battle:58ae4e1354ca8f4c.text: 「No good! This machine can't take any more!」

battle:285efb273d393a31.text: 「This is a battle I can't lose...!」

battle:87b406007d8e3bec.text: 「The fate of this planet is at stake...!」

battle:4aee3963d335c828.text: 「Now that I'm on the battlefield, I'll see this through!」

battle:e7e3c6e99afb196d.text: 「My mission is to annihilate the enemy...!」

battle:0d9d0102001b6f33.text: 「A chance! I can land another blow!」

battle:654014cf34bcff46.text: 「$$スフィア・リアクター$$s\nare top-priority targets!」

battle:ab871b10b5f1f4cd.text: 「I'll take you down before you can use your $$スフィア$$!」

battle:fe0c21f0e76e58f6.text: 「Return the $$スフィア$$ to its rightful owner!」

battle:5a55dd935215e558.text: 「You're using Earth's own military might to fight...!」

battle:f3ee87aaee2dbdf7.text: 「Looks like that huge body is too much for you to handle!」

battle:987d7fee159c65fe.text: 「Even a giant god won't make us flinch!」

battle:e5793b4c38f74fc0.text: 「Flush out the rat and finish it!」

battle:1a103d31b630a2e5.text: 「Making up for your lack of strength with speed!?」

battle:adcb95eb60704280.text: 「An ace-class opponent from the enemy forces!?」

battle:6624dd6bf3b7aa3e.text: 「Bring down the carrier and victory is ours!」

battle:cf3f6bd2e108d1f6.text: 「I'll free Earth from $$サイデリアル$$!」

battle:838aa9746151366f.text: 「I'll use $$スクランブル・エッジ$$...!」

battle:b42a6c6597e0c727.text: 「I've already got you in my sights!」

battle:73baa6d2ae2183f8.text: 「That's the $$リベレーター$$ for you!」

battle:2ce8c81cccd86f48.text: 「I'll show you my will to resist!」

battle:24fe8b3b9c3f769b.text: 「I won't let this end without hitting back!」

battle:7dc92e6fc3fc2c71.text: 「Coordinate our attacks and finish them for sure!」

battle:631419d8d45f7e2e.text: 「I can't let this trouble the commander...!」

battle:f14c19e98b8ca9d6.text: 「I'll protect you, even at the cost of my life...!」

battle:a5e7c676891d7c7e.text: 「I won't let you take down the commander!」

battle:3635def031a5106b.text: 「I'll pick them off one by one!」

battle:64a54e833ee89af8.text: 「A good tactic. Maybe I should learn from it...」

battle:ec524a425148a7b4.text: 「They're one or two steps ahead of me...!」

battle:e1c3a1f1f0860c4e.text: 「That's what you call a wasted attack.」

battle:f562b66823dfb80d.text: 「Stay calm, and you can see it's nothing special.」

battle:f8262825f0fe0b87.text: 「I'm a member of the $$クロノ$$ action force too!」

battle:f6935fb60bdea6fd.text: 「I knew what was coming\nfrom the moment you started moving!」

battle:67b51239ead00795.text: 「An attack like that won't hurt me!」

battle:f4dc31fce2cd10df.text: 「I never thought you'd land a hit...!」

battle:4a590e16c1a1eabe.text: 「Even your attacks show how weak you are!」

battle:78c7aa815e2fb854.text: 「I can't let my guard down against this opponent...!」

battle:8b968cfd1690ae68.text: 「I won't make the same mistake twice!」

battle:e4ee4274974a4dec.text: 「No one in $$クロノ$$ flinches at mere pain!」

battle:95b9e21dcac00f45.text: 「Did I black out for a moment!?」

battle:8891c69cee4f6821.text: 「The damage is about to exceed the limit!」

battle:f9b070d6c13f57da.text: 「As a member of $$クロノ$$, I can't lose!」

battle:f0e7e588135ebef9.text: 「No...!\nAt this rate, I'll lose the commander's trust!」

battle:cafedb211ec9a353.text: 「It's no use...! The machine's going to explode!」

battle:2427197e517a0760.text: 「We'll protect Earth with our own hands!」

battle:a10ede9cd7ed4ba3.text: 「I'll prove myself an asset to the commander!」

battle:381e46b34bc45676.text: 「There's no choice but to do this...!」

battle:59e749326c21b91a.text: 「I believe in the $$アスクレプス$$'s power...!」

battle:5b0d6805ee5f062e.text: 「I'll defeat you and free our Earth!」

battle:905d617f3a925760.text: 「So the mastermind behind the $$クロノ$$ $$保守派$$ has appeared!」

battle:131150861fb45062.text: 「I won't be poisoned by the scorpion!」

battle:a919f8473a432bd0.text: 「I won't forgive you for betraying the commander!」

battle:055416dbb380917d.text: 「$$セツコ$$!\nI never wanted to fight you!」

battle:cfd82b7cd5851e83.text: 「Even if my opponent is you, $$ランド$$,\nI won't flinch!」

battle:daed0665e07f84a8.text: 「$$クロウ$$!\nI have no more doubts either!」

battle:eeef2f3179e4b459.text: 「Using Earth-made weapons as your own fighting force...!」

battle:7cc28d9e3289a7d3.text: 「The enemy is no better than insects! No mercy!」

battle:b642ab745ad008ab.text: 「The carrier is the target...! I'll take it down swiftly!」

battle:dd798a8cd6a65a87.text: 「If I can hit the bridge directly...!」

battle:78109c8047620936.text: 「I won't let you have your way!」

battle:f2bf11c0740af30a.text: 「I'll use $$スクランブル・エッジ$$!」

battle:1292e50b01c8a5fb.text: 「I'll do it just like the commander!」

battle:113ed939aad2a881.text: 「Serpents, we'll finish it in one blow!」
