battle:f4ce66e12720d5ff.text: 「This is the $$アスクレプス$$'s power!」

battle:81fddcfe5523d2eb.text: 「The time for lying low is over!」

battle:d7ed08875302898a.text: 「Resistance is a right granted to the living!」

battle:5b93256bd76cc88a.text: 「So this is the power of $$ザ・ヒート$$...!」

battle:640fa8d8fab2c23a.text: 「I won't let you hurt someone who shares our cause!」

battle:c2ff78664c278155.text: 「Leave this to me and fall back!」

battle:922bedf65afbdc7e.text: 「Tough as you are,\nthat's far too reckless, $$ランド$$!」

battle:a75f926776af94b3.text: 「You can't die\nand leave your debts behind, $$クロウ$$!」

battle:7b3ca67973120367.text: 「This is part of a deputy commander's duty too!」

battle:db43da034694b8aa.text: 「I'll turn the tide in our favor!」

battle:7326ff663a893f98.text: 「I'll stop the enemy in their tracks!」

battle:f84358d426fcbeac.text: 「All I can do is stand by and watch...!」

battle:80407b61ce57159b.text: 「Have I fallen into the enemy's trap...!」

battle:cd035960dbb2dfd1.text: 「No...! I've lost sight of the enemy unit!」

battle:917e3d133661c9fe.text: 「Your attacks have such a predictable rhythm!」

battle:227933efefee29d7.text: 「The commander chose me. I can handle this much!」

battle:bb4a3ab0560dceda.text: 「Mass-produced or not, I can't let this get scratched!」

battle:1f30aae4f3e75b04.text: 「I can't let the commander see this failure.」

battle:6cafff1bf402cdc2.text: 「This much is no problem at all!」

battle:a4df039e71944558.text: 「To get hit by something like that...!」

battle:7918c5241e91f8bf.text: 「You're still testing me at this point...?」

battle:aba2cf208f25784f.text: 「As long as it doesn't hinder the operation!」

battle:6d092ac9afcdfb2c.text: 「I've let the $$アスクレプス$$ get scratched...!」

battle:9224f0ffabcb6af4.text: 「At this rate, the damage\nwill just keep adding up...!」

battle:409932f63e2f3a24.text: 「If I don't turn the tide, I'll be overwhelmed...!」

battle:6ce7e5f0de870226.text: 「Have they figured out my evasive patterns...!?」

battle:88d5e9dbd4ea86ab.text: 「There's still something I can do! I won't give up!」

battle:affcda5547458661.text: 「At the very least, I can't let my spirit falter...!」

battle:933897b9feb865b1.text: 「I can't face the commander like this...!」

battle:c8cd4c009e69cda1.text: 「I can't die without the commander's permission!」

battle:b740b2b952695bbb.text: 「So this is $$ランド$$'s strength...!\nTruly fearsome power!」

battle:0846a7ebc7b09099.text: 「$$クロウ$$...! You're as strong as I thought...!」

battle:92bf19163f10391a.text: 「No...!\nEven the $$アスクレプス$$ can't take any more!」

battle:ca9cc5783b46aa80.text: 「I don't intend to show the enemy any mercy...!」

battle:8868600a56da29e6.text: 「Running into the $$ジェミニス$$ commander\nin a place like this...!」

battle:36ca566739f8a973.text: 「I won't let you\nhave your way with this $$蒼の地球$$!」

battle:19434bbe588fbca0.text: 「$$スフィア・リアクター$$s\nare top-priority targets...!」

battle:10a02715f0b371d4.text: 「Even a $$リアクター$$ can't be invincible!」

battle:eb0b1bd77bc908a3.text: 「The bigger the opponent,\nthe more fired up I get...!」

battle:cd03c5c3728f6c95.text: 「The bigger the machine,\nthe more blind spots it has...!」

battle:a09145c4bf65e2e0.text: 「So small, it's hard to get a bead on you...!」

battle:d1902c5227e95d6d.text: 「I'll show you I can fight ships too...!」

battle:fa78c2b2cbf50b3d.text: 「If I stay in sync with my ally...!」

battle:790763723dfadc5d.text: 「We can't afford to lose the commander!」

battle:87747b1628c652df.text: 「You won't have time to look at anyone else!」

battle:6d1dc9c6276051c0.text: 「I need to hand off the baton smoothly!」

battle:142c5764e79c457a.text: 「This attack will draw the enemy's attention!」

battle:77692f04da723835.text: 「I'm not settling for just a diversion!」

battle:844fdde1304181b9.text: 「It'll be bad if this keeps up...」

battle:a66163f1dcdbba4d.text: 「Feels like I've walked right into the enemy's trap...!」

battle:fa8e0eaad5cb97ab.text: 「Not good...!\nI have to get out of here quickly!」

battle:f1ae83d4eafec48a.text: 「An attack like that gets a failing grade!」

battle:b335f004304c60e0.text: 「If you thought that would hit, you were sorely mistaken!」

battle:83352b437b4950b4.text: 「I won't let you scratch the $$アスクレプス$$!」

battle:1331ce54f3a700e2.text: 「Too bad. I can see everything you're doing.」

battle:5ab9933acaf2f208.text: 「Is that the only kind of attack you can manage?」

battle:053a52a34fc48097.text: 「This is part of the $$アスクレプス$$'s power too.」

battle:72f86bc6e3dcdf69.text: 「Looks like it's not my lucky day.」

battle:4bbd0b7f9c48a897.text: 「If that's your best, it's pretty sad.」

battle:952c46534b135085.text: 「Don't tell me you're celebrating a lucky hit?」

battle:527ce58f6ccf7520.text: 「If I hold out, my chance to win will come...!」

battle:81e3e6d25144aa1f.text: 「I've got a bit of a bad feeling...」

battle:32b16d30bf3406ff.text: 「Looks like I got a little too carried away.」

battle:3403af16fb3db875.text: 「It's not time to panic yet...! But...!」

battle:c43b65be35316f53.text: 「Time to refocus...!\nThe real fight starts here!」

battle:4263a8811fa2fa3e.text: 「For the $$アスクレプス$$\nto take this much damage...!」

battle:927b705bf55c0bb5.text: 「Me, a chosen warrior, in a place like this...!」

battle:3c5811d1104d3a0f.text: 「I'll do everything I can before I fall...!」

battle:619c46e7e8ffba9c.text: 「The commander is with me...!\nSo there's no way I'll lose!」

battle:53f75c3004f3290d.text: 「If I have time to complain,\nI have time to do something!」

battle:76f10936026299c9.text: 「For the commander, for $$クロノ$$,\nI can't lose!」

battle:57604cfc0ce05e1d.text: 「I'll use $$スクランブル・エッジ$$!」

battle:84862e48f5d3535a.text: 「Now your soul will be freed too...」

battle:520f7c0596ff9db0.text: 「I can't let you get away with that!」

battle:de68af681ad5906e.text: 「Looks like you need a little punishment!」

battle:e5bdd448d1c0cd45.text: 「I can't let it end without fighting back!」

battle:6660f91514f1f912.text: 「Eliminate anything that stands in the way!」

battle:78bdafc4067f8962.text: 「My mission is to annihilate the enemy!」

battle:6312dbef45f1c7a3.text: 「I don't intend to settle for a supporting role...!」

battle:1f88dc1eb217bb29.text: 「Transport ship or not, we have weapons!」

battle:077e68c7c7e437ec.text: 「We'll free Earth from $$サイデリアル$$!」

battle:5aa7782c6fdeee40.text: 「Even this will do if it hits dead-on...!」

battle:9e6c350d69d9949c.text: 「We won't let this end as a one-sided beating!」

battle:e7ae44b7d5e0a37c.text: 「Coordinate our attacks and finish them for sure!」

battle:01dd9e68d0547f20.text: 「Even at the cost of our lives, we must at least save the commander...!」
battle:01dd9e68d0547f20.notes: Meaning proof: 隊長だけは stresses that the commander, at least, must be saved. Current English omits だけは and leaves 'the commander must' without the protective meaning established by adjacent support-defense lines.

battle:d8d9fc9634cc3716.text: 「A good tactic. We should learn from it.」

battle:98fcf6ec8d7c353b.text: 「That's what you call a wasted attack.」

battle:65e5afd517782154.text: 「Even the $$グリンアース$$ can manage this much...!」

battle:346fac8d3fd945f8.text: 「The $$グリンアース$$ won't fall to this much...!」

battle:4886eeaa44930eb1.text: 「So evasion is impossible in this ship...!」

battle:ad208046cb5038ab.text: 「At this rate,\nwe'll eventually run out of options!」

battle:ea5f5f5c3225dfc7.text: 「As members of $$クロノ$$, we can't lose!」

battle:c5665b78a0933fe8.text: 「No...! At this rate, we'll lose the commander's trust!」

battle:e4c81160bddb7d64.text: 「At this rate, the $$グリンアース$$ will...!」

battle:9940a6a824b4f117.text: 「The $$グリンアース$$... is going down...!」

battle:0a6fd57da9aabb54.text: 「It's no use...! The ship's going to explode!」

battle:0a9076e403836bd6.text: 「The attack target has already been confirmed!」

battle:dfc374eaec89655f.text: 「I'll fulfill my duty as a soldier of the Empire!」

battle:9042edeccc28868f.text: 「You're still fighting, even in this situation!?」

battle:290a9c0bb8816988.text: 「I'll make you realize your own foolishness!」

battle:8389341ad246ec0b.text: 「Resist, and there will be no mercy!」

battle:02db5cf1f8755376.text: 「Do you want to die that badly!?」

battle:7630916279d27da4.text: 「There's no place for you on this Earth!」

battle:edcdaca25e2528d4.text: 「Purge those who will not obey the Emperor!」

battle:4cef8aea6091cfbb.text: 「We are the sword and shield of the $$新地球皇国$$!」

battle:80e74e53af00cb8c.text: 「Eliminate anything that becomes an enemy of the Empire!」

battle:382db052e98c0c8c.text: 「The rebels will face the ultimate punishment!」

battle:c2b8034125211303.notes: Rath Babylon identity verified by root as Sidereal's imperial capital; Latin spelling remains provisional, so needs_review is preserved despite the resolved glossary reference. Independent proof: Existing Rath Babylon spelling flag retained. Proper-name research is outside this meaning proof; glossary reference preserves the source place identity.

battle:65b69ceb0b326fec.text: 「Wretches who dare approach the Emperor's castle!」

battle:01094635fb081a78.text: 「Stray dogs who've wandered into the imperial capital!」

battle:89ef2f05403376fa.text: 「Our duty is to protect the Emperor!」

battle:116f79ec9128ecc5.text: 「Rebels! We won't let you near the Emperor!」

battle:be82300dc4c0af1d.text: 「Run, and I'll shoot you from behind!」

battle:0f1b5c1457c77d52.text: 「If I can just get inside the enemy's guard!」

battle:999b60877850b3d7.text: 「I'll show you the gap in our skills!」

battle:13872ad995c52bbe.text: 「If I rush in all at once!」

battle:57d6216cf5d7b1e7.text: 「You failed to escape. Your luck has run out!」

battle:0001d5a546be36d8.text: 「If the enemy commander has come out, we need only strike!」

battle:507d34ec02811c83.text: 「Bring down the battleship and the fight is decided!」

battle:90b48f5843d3e2b8.text: 「Against a battleship, just aim for the bridge or power section!」

battle:cb9f9cd3a8323eb5.text: 「A $$スフィア・リアクター$$ on Earth's side!?」

battle:84d9f9f6e23068d0.text: 「All the $$スフィア$$s' power\nwill belong to $$サイデリアル$$!」

battle:0987d2d0c3b11ef2.text: 「You think I'll let you pull out!?」

battle:95ecb412102e9a49.text: 「Don't think you'll get away with this!」

battle:25e70e6ebd200e75.text: 「Run, and I'll shoot you in the back!」

battle:7d6c409e9195dbeb.text: 「I won't miss my chance to counterattack!」

battle:653217d028a97585.text: 「Allow me to follow up as well!」

battle:f683242053123b44.text: 「It is an honor\nto serve as the Emperor's shield!」

battle:58f1f0a6d96a0b65.text: 「Commander-in-Chief! Please fall back while you can!」

battle:e5f5ba5b3497ddf8.text: 「Pick them off one by one? Understood!」

battle:c47f1129502a8492.text: 「Stay out of this! I can handle it alone!」

battle:a1a89127fd5c92cf.text: 「Not good! I can't counterattack like this!」

battle:b6084ebb3e1b770c.text: 「Humiliating!\nAll I can do is watch the enemy leave!?」

battle:835f69eb2e31a9a0.text: 「Did the enemy attack knowing this would happen!?」

battle:6f13020f3d34c6de.text: 「In this position, I'm just an easy target!」

battle:a1dcd13bb4bb28bb.text: 「If I don't move, another attack will come!」

battle:856eb5cccaaa69ac.text: 「That's the extent of an Earthling's skill!」

battle:d2d6dca5a0c487db.text: 「Looks like my machine has the edge!」

battle:5635089907851375.text: 「An attack like that won't hurt me.」

battle:c604d074aa58983d.text: 「Do you understand how futile it is now?」

battle:6fee39b757a7f315.text: 「I'll simply block it with the field!」

battle:f4e099a5fcb51522.text: 「Don't get cocky just because you landed a hit!」

battle:11798ac7322cef89.text: 「Just a scratch! It won't affect the operation!」

battle:1bef822c72cc2c37.text: 「You dare resist us with so little power!?」

battle:1126f71f4cce77aa.text: 「I can't worry about a little damage!」

battle:b53f50b3a16ce92a.text: 「Are you deliberately trying to anger me!?」

battle:d1acd9a9328fa7de.text: 「Is this enemy exceptional even among Earthlings!?」

battle:7cafb4009b31d757.text: 「Don't think you'll get away with this!」

battle:dc8f47081c771b05.text: 「As long as the machine moves, that's enough!」

battle:a843ba53637fbfe6.text: 「A precise attack...! Not to be underestimated!」

battle:52c511a6fd077b8f.text: 「You have some skill, but this is as far as you go!」

battle:0cf07fbf287fd2c1.text: 「I see how you've survived this long!」

battle:e035dd46bcba64c9.text: 「I have to at least acknowledge your persistence!」

battle:d39f2d978d509c4b.text: 「So this... is a $$スフィア$$'s power!」

battle:7cfd3de5505d4e69.text: 「The machine can still move...! In that case!」

battle:ff4313c747719207.text: 「I'll take that one down myself, even if we die together...!」

battle:01828809d5c86fed.text: 「To be pushed this far by an Earthling...!」

battle:27dd39bfe5dd3ecd.text: 「I-I have to admit it...!\nThis one is strong!」

battle:82f3befcf75cffe9.text: 「No!\nAt this rate, all I can do is wait to be destroyed!」

battle:ea452b3f22e7c312.text: 「Both the monitor and sensors are dead!?」

battle:10eff7d448043fe1.text: 「Damn you...! How dare a mere Earthling do this!」

battle:0bffbbd8c4271a02.text: 「Why must this happen to me\non the edge of the galaxy...!?」

battle:1f5528f4b73151e6.text: 「Impossible! Me, in a place like this...!」

battle:736ac968a3da41c0.text: 「A-At the limit! I have to eject...!」

battle:eba1f6f0bc15d5c9.text: 「It's hopeless! I have to abandon the machine!」

battle:47e8a5e2a9726ea8.text: 「All the $$スフィア$$s' power\nwill belong to $$サイデリアル$$!」

battle:b4b4b91707da487a.text: 「Humiliating!\nAll I can do is watch the enemy leave!?」

battle:f57cfede68ba3e35.text: 「Do you understand how futile it is now?」

battle:735fc77348a8541e.text: 「I-I have to admit it...!\nThis one is strong!」

battle:5d1b6ccf586294d2.text: 「No!\nAt this rate, all I can do is wait to be destroyed!」

battle:c6883c7ed261faca.text: 「Now then, shall we have a bout?」

battle:c80a25d05ab7ba1a.text: 「It seems there's no choice but to do this.」

battle:246b1ae3c5958dc5.text: 「Well, then, I look forward to our little match.」

battle:ce45f8ae5d01482e.text: 「Well, well...\nLet's put in a little effort without getting ourselves killed!」

battle:6d01befd7ce31064.text: 「Are you sure you should\nbe wasting time on a nobody like me?」

battle:95983a92193780bf.text: 「Now, how long can I hold out?」
battle:95983a92193780bf.notes: どこまで踏ん張れますかな can grammatically refer to self or opponent. The surrounding self-deprecating lines favor 'how long can I hold out'; needs speaker/voice-cue confirmation. Independent proof: Existing omitted-subject flag retained. Neighboring Saldias lines combine self-deprecation (2230/2232) with addressing the opponent (2224/2225); either 'how long can I hold out' or 'how long can you hold out' fits the bare Japanese. No unambiguous pronoun evidence in the adjacent sequence, so no forced correction.

battle:97c9b7b0f457de11.text: 「I'd appreciate it if you went easy on me.」

battle:cd6c1c0c299aa777.text: 「I'm afraid I'll have to get a little rough.」

battle:5ec8d8a9ee9ad813.text: 「Let's take it easy. Nice and easy.」

battle:317ed1cef5a877f3.text: 「$$サルディアス・アクス$$, age 42.\nI'll give it my best!」

battle:ad043d9e5796f658.text: 「Even a lowly soldier has some pride, you know.」

battle:8a967e2816d46ef9.text: 「I'll get to work!\nThose who don't work don't eat, after all!」

battle:04f62c4c19c50d4b.text: 「Show me\nthat pride of the galactic frontier.」

battle:ddec4250d658f70d.text: 「You're welcome to call me\na sneaky coward.」

battle:c5af570680560e8b.text: 「Shall I unleash\nthe hatred sleeping within you?」

battle:cca73406658e5532.text: 「This is part of the job too. No hard feelings.」

battle:b1638bc70bc86a66.text: 「Believe it or not, I'm rather greedy by nature.」

battle:797cbcb8971092aa.text: 「Would you mind letting me capture you quietly,\n$$セツコ$$?」

battle:beb24698bf38fece.text: 「I'd rather not\nmake you any sadder, but...」

battle:70c2b688cab2522e.text: 「So my opponent is $$ランド$$, the glutton\nwho reeks of sweat and even has smelly feet.」

battle:1e3ff965b2ce95f8.text: 「Let me see just how far\nthat toughness of yours goes, $$ランド$$.」

battle:ec55b3420c89dfc2.text: 「You understand the obligations of making a living,\ndon't you, $$クロウ$$?」

battle:c6ff5a1f49c17698.text: 「If possible, I'd have preferred\nto settle things with you using money...」

battle:acd8c35a534ac360.text: 「Now then, let's have our bout,\nCommander $$アドヴェント$$.」

battle:b4a29e6bec98fb3c.text: 「Hmm... As ever,\nyou're a difficult person to pin down...」

battle:e5ec7e6ae02c6c76.text: 「You've done a lot for me too, $$ブルー$$, but...」

battle:dfacc6ed5255e8b7.text: 「I'll never forget the taste of your cooking.」

battle:72078bfdc6a039e8.text: 「A battle between commanders...\nThis should be quite a spectacle.」

battle:e38ad9928e04c2b0.text: 「You appear to be an ace.\nPlease go easy on me.」

battle:45e8a5c8be423cda.text: 「They say big men have small brains...\nLet's see, shall we?」

battle:6a2137a36603440e.text: 「Never drop your guard, even against a small opponent...\nA cardinal rule of the battlefield.」

battle:a92ab74be8817e60.text: 「Shall we go after a big catch this time?」

battle:628058f41d485101.text: 「Now... A direct hit to the bridge, and it's the end.」

battle:2bc08d52e8c03b46.text: 「That stiff, formal attitude\njust doesn't suit me.」

battle:7a5e37523d752e39.text: 「Working me to the bone for peanuts!\nSomething like that.」

battle:0ca736a445d8d780.text: 「I'm branded a traitor now,\nfighting after casting everything aside.」

battle:eecf79016b3b99f0.text: 「You really are a frightening person, yes.」

battle:7371b4fd0bf9eab1.text: 「Ugh... Just getting close\nfeels like it's wearing away my life.」

battle:c96ee350d0c01a64.text: 「Still the same as ever,\nMr. $$ギルター・ベローネ$$...」

battle:dcd130e52a2146a0.text: 「The things you do\nreally are rather pathetic...」

battle:2752dc5defcb730d.text: 「This is war, after all...\nI use weapons like this too.」

battle:45af09dac70c38e9.text: 「This will seep right through to the person inside!」

battle:308b858ad35c836f.text: 「This machine prides itself on its power.」

battle:f93fa91c57541cfc.text: 「Too bad!\nNow that you've come this far, there's no escape!」

battle:8d7f4c6775fe988b.text: 「At this point, there's nothing for it but to charge!」

battle:c0162d58ce5ff108.text: 「I'm sorry. This is my job too.」

battle:16959bd7b0679b25.text: 「Would you mind getting hit if I fire at random?」

battle:6b48b7ae6e9ba3e6.text: 「I tend to close my eyes when I shoot...」

battle:4c5e64f1b4f06989.text: 「Now then, shall we begin the counterattack?」

battle:10e919872daf9997.text: 「It would be rather galling\nto just take a beating.」

battle:1b02102f35ca9d34.text: 「Could you let me take over the attacking now?」

battle:9f2eafaba63257ef.text: 「Oh, too bad! Offense and defense trade places here!」

battle:d899469742ee4384.text: 「Surprisingly enough, I do hold a grudge.」

battle:0d4fbde469fc1bdb.text: 「Oh my... At that pace, I can catch you.」

battle:4a61b557fe5d4bbd.text: 「Your position is quite obvious, you know.」

battle:8ba16f55fd8dd553.text: 「Excuse me!\nI'm still alive, so I'll be counterattacking!」

battle:c213765f2758447a.text: 「I'll help myself to the rest, then.」

battle:1cd37c81579774e7.text: 「I can almost smell\n$$セツコ$$'s lingering fragrance.」

battle:76870b13870a1bb2.text: 「Just what I'd expect of The Cr... Whoops.」

battle:035dd3df5bcf906b.text: 「So you don't just wander around aimlessly.」

battle:53195fa145bc3367.text: 「My, impressive as ever, Commander $$アドヴェント$$.」

battle:483e23ee16d9e058.text: 「A solid attack, just like you, $$ブルー$$.」

battle:587095401e9b40d3.text: 「Do put in some proper work, $$ギルター$$.」

battle:b296398ea4280ccf.text: 「Oh dear... My body moved forward on its own...!」

battle:338d17cf0470c423.text: 「It can't be helped.\nI'll handle this one!」

battle:f6c4131e30aed878.text: 「You mustn't lay a hand on a maiden!」

battle:a35ba9ea7e38f03a.text: 「Well... For you, $$ランド$$,\nthis is probably needless meddling.」

battle:f9f35ebd834b2e39.text: 「How unusual for the commander to let their guard down.」

battle:08b451f3869427f6.text: 「$$ブルー$$, you need to relax a little more.」

battle:699e179aaf9b1671.text: 「You're a little too eager, $$クラヴィア$$!」

battle:91d5ecda680910e4.text: 「How many favors do you owe me now,\n$$ギルター$$?」

battle:ae769435a7411a2a.text: 「Please don't be angry if I can't beat them.」

battle:21030b1c06447961.text: 「I'd rather you didn't expect too much...」

battle:22b41a3b3821d74a.text: 「Consider it a bonus if it works!」

battle:3af99e997112be2a.text: 「Oh? Could it be... I'm the decoy!?」

battle:64295dcb7212fb41.text: 「Oh dear! Unable to counterattack? What an oversight!」

battle:e848ebbcba679d78.text: 「All I can do is see the enemy off... My heart's all aflutter.」

battle:2024e8f44b0315aa.text: 「No moves left...?\nI'm ashamed of my own incompetence.」

battle:7baad23d51f98d67.text: 「How's that?\nSuch nimble moves, you'd never think I was 42!」

battle:65ecb067901f7dcb.text: 「No damage,\nbut that did put a little strain on my back!」

battle:8a8f5c87f221bc3a.text: 「Believe it or not, I'm a man who gets things done.」

battle:44846e67b1b9e9c8.text: 「Well, that's the wisdom of age for you, yes.」

battle:249fde3de5bf62a8.text: 「Is that the extent of your ability?」

battle:f03586d5c128ccd9.text: 「So this really is the best you can manage...」

battle:b87650bba62cbbc0.text: 「Isn't this a little embarrassing\nfor a $$リアクター$$?」

battle:5e616a6f895746f9.text: 「It's all right.\nDon't hold back on using your $$スフィア$$'s power.」

battle:8ac9ca0c74f28b28.text: 「Shall I say the forbidden name, $$ランド$$?」

battle:ca481c5825a58f9d.text: 「Would you mind trying again another day?」

battle:00ef85b3c2d9b3e5.text: 「Too bad! That doesn't work on me.」

battle:564dd6600ec76195.text: 「I'm deeply grateful for this lovely equipment!」

battle:06eea34c995aed85.text: 「No luck...\nToday's simply not my lucky day.」

battle:cb5105e35a3a10eb.text: 「Ah... Well...\nEven monkeys fall from trees, you know.」

battle:77d05e47a90b3335.text: 「When you get older, your reflexes... Well, you know?」

battle:d91e1cf5a4a650ad.text: 「I knew it was coming, I really did,\nand yet here we are...」

battle:6cf3edf0bfcecfcb.text: 「I looked for the trick behind the trick,\nand it was a straightforward attack after all. Yes...」

battle:86d8a3917dff887a.text: 「You see?\nThere was no need to dodge.」

battle:5c57af9cc34e6e50.text: 「If I were ten years younger, this wouldn't have...」

battle:e88c36fc7788c373.text: 「Oh my! This is a bit of a problem...」

battle:a7386f59e058e62c.text: 「Woe is me. Coming all this way to earn a living,\nonly to end up like this...」

battle:ea48a48d900b3b5c.text: 「Come to think of it... This is my unlucky year...」

battle:4d2807665aca81e6.text: 「As you get older, your body\njust can't keep up...」

battle:9d0ace1065dc16cb.text: 「As expected of someone branded with the $$烙印$$.」

battle:fcc671470bd2e717.text: 「Ouch! Isn't this what they call\na major crisis!?」

battle:fab443908fdcc28f.text: 「Could you at least let me go...?\nNo, I suppose you wouldn't.」

battle:417ce0706d96ad92.text: 「It really does seem\nto be my unlucky day.」

battle:319e39591a31a54e.text: 「Oh? Am I in a hopeless situation!?」

battle:676240631a2c8e4b.text: 「Haha...\nI was a fool to think I could win...」

battle:98133d4cd6aee5e4.text: 「Oh no! My life is flashing before my eyes!」

battle:fe7d18abca07e653.text: 「Making a comeback from here\nwill be rather difficult...」

battle:40d44b0cb551043e.text: 「Ah...\nI can hear the family I left back home...!」

battle:6f16c74e3c0cac77.text: 「That indomitable fighting spirit...\nSomething that was lost still exists here.」

battle:ae849343f42ce9bf.text: 「As someone with responsibilities,\nI can't afford to go down.」

battle:5bfa0540accc3b63.text: 「You really are the number-one man\nI'd never want as my boss...!」

battle:69fc200f694304e2.text: 「What little life I have left\nis being drained away even further!」

battle:ff1a68e3611f3f8f.text: 「Ooh...!\nHardly a blow you'd expect from a maiden!」

battle:bfd24d5c14d71173.text: 「It seems your nickname\nisn't just for show...!」

battle:cd8fb8fea6f1b934.text: 「Oh dear...!\nMy aging eyes can't follow those movements!」

battle:8315a27380a79b22.text: 「Well, you got me!\nTo end in a place like this...」

battle:6d06492d441303c1.text: 「O-Oh...! This is no good at all!」

battle:bff14d54c610080c.text: 「Don't think a mere Earthling can win!」

battle:5e3aa5be39333296.text: 「All we have to do is crush the enemy!」

battle:72baa6fd31ee1d7c.text: 「I'll show you how $$ジェミニス$$ fights!」

battle:12ae6a11993d2395.text: 「The pride of $$ジェミニス$$ lives on within me!」

battle:58a3741ffe24048d.text: 「If you want someone to hate, hate them!」

battle:5b8adce6a94c2a00.text: 「Then we'll just have to fight head-on!」

battle:63b74c255c5823a0.text: 「In a head-on fight, I won't fall behind!」

battle:c587e60203b4f04c.text: 「I'll show you the power of $$ディオスク$$!」

battle:2e7e46e3907e7487.text: 「As long as I'm piloting this machine,\nI can't afford to lose!」

battle:b07878b514a899ed.text: 「This $$ディオスク$$ is an extension of my own body!」

battle:dfa568913bd5f75a.text: 「That looks like the core of the enemy's forces!」

battle:223d862ca11f6d71.text: 「The target is a battleship! Aim for the bridge!」

battle:b0872c1313ddd70e.text: 「How long will you keep getting in our way?!」

battle:4e7d2f9435bd89e2.text: 「I'll show you $$ジェミニス$$ combat techniques!」

battle:37c1305196d51331.text: 「I'll show you pilot and machine fighting as one!」

battle:cf7f273ddbc2db25.text: 「This is $$ジェミニス・コマンド・アーツ$$!」

battle:ee5f49491f70c164.text: 「This is what happens when you don't retreat fast enough!」

battle:0ecd9efdc7d5c34c.text: 「Your luck ran out when you targeted me!」

battle:063c7d527982f71c.text: 「You don't have time for a breather!」

battle:565e1d3996273444.text: 「An attack like that... I'll take it!」

battle:a331d0bf8ef4ae01.text: 「I won't let you take down my comrade!」

battle:248ddddcc5613617.text: 「I won't let you take down the captain!」

battle:ddff38dc01bcc8e0.text: 「I'd gladly serve as $$ジェミニア$$'s shield!」

battle:f1953bfbbe857e46.text: 「We'll concentrate our attacks on that one!」

battle:6dee8e4b4903341c.text: 「I'll pin them down! The rest is up to you!」

battle:30ab7f51509abbd6.text: 「Don't think I'll just sit here as a target!」

battle:efe742a21578329a.text: 「So you know the basics of tactics...!」

battle:1d239e4b80d2dfa1.text: 「I won't call it cheap...!\n It's a valid tactic!」

battle:77c751219a5a0a1e.text: 「Good tactics...! But it won't work twice!」

battle:679b16ab0ac8b1eb.text: 「It's useless, no matter how many times you try!」

battle:cb36902de0725440.text: 「You think such a sloppy attack will work!?」

battle:f4a05fd2d4a946a1.text: 「The $$ディオスク$$\n can use telekinetic control!」

battle:7840c420d8cadd63.text: 「You keep putting up this useless resistance!」

battle:dcf72f2e57b9a3ef.text: 「That wasn't enough to get through the field!」

battle:1a0232388eb228c9.text: 「Did I let my guard down somewhere...!?」

battle:875988c833b4fe53.text: 「That was nothing but an accidental collision!」

battle:dd07d56c22f2fbea.text: 「At this point, a scratch or two won't...!」

battle:9b3b94db86c90971.text: 「You landed a hit on the $$ディオスク$$...!」

battle:f13d3e9542074e28.text: 「To think I'd take a direct hit...!」

battle:c0a6b93da35c650d.text: 「I can't afford to keep taking hits like this...!」

battle:9342a6fdabc17f3a.text: 「Damn it! What a pain you are!」

battle:f520313c02874407.text: 「You still haven't learned to stop resisting!?」

battle:5c43e28d746490f9.text: 「Damn it!\n And I'm piloting a $$ディオスク$$...!」

battle:342a95973ea42af7.text: 「Even telekinetic control\n can't dodge it completely...!?」

battle:839325ec033eaf91.text: 「Are you saying you're more skilled than me!?」

battle:334223caf038f899.text: 「This is bad...! Damage is exceeding the limit!」

battle:a18fa04f6e633040.text: 「Damn it!\n Is this where I'm going to die!?」

battle:fc126d49082a4351.text: 「I haven't taken a beating like this\n since that battle...!」

battle:6ea9733fcc6424bc.text: 「It's too soon for this to end!\n I can still fight!」

battle:64ccd3a4b2fcff06.text: 「You Earthling! That was a clever trick!」

battle:d937a733e0c6e5e7.text: 「A moment's mistake\n led to all this...!」

battle:e7c219179047d6d6.text: 「Fires are breaking out\n all over the cockpit!」

battle:5c253d382a0d8d0b.text: 「Damn it!\n It's because they put me in this machine...!」

battle:6a5acf2e8451e77c.text: 「If only I could use telekinetic control,\n this wouldn't have happened...!」

battle:71996fa94a1c4f54.text: 「Damn it!\n I'm piloting a $$ディオスク$$!」

battle:e704178f77ad8b95.text: 「Is this the end for me and the $$ディオスク$$...!?」

battle:0b38f6c998ef9f5c.text: 「Is this it...!? Is this really the end!?」

battle:0d3e339a01b6da29.text: 「Damn it! Out here on the fringes of the galaxy...!」

battle:985e985769b9b946.text: 「N-no good! The machine can't hold out any longer!」

battle:e5d2f26adc01917d.text: 「This is bad! The machine's going to explode!」

battle:af56018534180406.text: 「No! The $$ディオスク$$'s been taken out!」

battle:84da4c9e8952cc21.text: 「There's no time to catch your breath!」

battle:f5d96009f073f0c4.text: 「The $$ディオスク$$ can\n use telekinetic control!」

battle:c7622da9f0e352bd.text: 「How can something that size have so much combat power!?」

battle:48ebab546357f6b2.text: 「I have\n $$ＧＳコンバット・アクション$$!」

battle:f1bc4177729d35c7.text: 「I'll show you how $$グローリー・スター$$ fights!」

battle:80f57e0076de7caa.text: 「I'll become a warrior...!\n To fulfill my mission!」

battle:6bd0daece08bf5f4.text: 「This is $$グローリー・スター$$!\n Commencing attack!」

battle:a87e074ccaccd666.text: 「I should be able to do it now...!」

battle:17276845861d1564.text: 「$$バルゴラ$$ is\n drawing out my power...!」

battle:131e0a42a2f2eeaa.text: 「Aim for the center of the machine...! I won't miss!」

battle:899c1192b2762c18.text: 「$$ガナリー・カーバー$$,\n close-range mode!」

battle:d80f4c02b83c6047.text: 「The secret to close combat lies in breathing...!」

battle:f797d9ca8a6cdea9.text: 「I saw an opening...! One more hit!」

battle:f1ea8600717641b5.text: 「This is no time\n for humans to fight each other...!」

battle:fad86c341a7b784e.text: 「I won't lose to people who can't see what's happening to the world...!」
battle:fad86c341a7b784e.notes: Predicate is incomplete in Japanese; supplied refusal to lose from attack context needs meaning proof. Independent proof: The supplied 'I won't lose' is plausible battle-context completion of the clipped なんかに predicate, but not explicit. Retain existing needs_review; a fragment-only rendering is also possible.

battle:5b9cda17d4115aee.text: 「Attack target: enemy commander...! I'll settle this!」

battle:ddbfcb9a1080003f.text: 「The chief said...\n If they hit you, hit back!」

battle:c7111d6373720698.text: 「I can see an opening as they pull back...!」

battle:9955fb28e4ac590f.text: 「If I stay on the defensive, I'll be pushed back...!」

battle:ea4960dc831d4e68.text: 「I'm not going to sit here as a target...!」

battle:e44adffa81dbb86f.text: 「I can't keep letting others protect me...!」

battle:e06027eb2cdc846c.text: 「I won't let you hurt any more of the people I care about!」

battle:bdd1a478e43ee9d2.text: 「No matter who the opponent is, one-on-one...!」

battle:647f5f254de6ed79.text: 「I can't counterattack...!? Such an elementary mistake!」

battle:afb7c854e8e303e8.text: 「They know how worn down I am...!?」

battle:2592944f884b699e.text: 「I'm at the wrong range...! I have to move, quickly!」

battle:b051ad6a6c48398f.text: 「From here, even the $$ガナリー・カーバー$$\n can't counterattack...!」

battle:620e061a82a51b2f.text: 「Am I getting a little better at reading trajectories...?」

battle:f1c9a1ea7772cbfb.text: 「Looks like my training is paying off.」

battle:931c6998fceb0c6f.text: 「Not yet...!\n $$バルゴラ$$ should be able to move better!」

battle:8da7f9dba841e59a.text: 「Against an attack like this, the barrier...!」

battle:3312e0c9c4b03ed0.text: 「I shouldn't be relying on the barrier, but...!」

battle:d5f9ae4358e63940.text: 「Guh...! I let $$バルゴラ$$ get damaged...」

battle:69e33b68f7e16cee.text: 「If I flinch at damage,\n I won't be able to fight!」

battle:3aad6f693013cccf.text: 「$$バルゴラ$$ can\n withstand this much...!」

battle:430f756945edd867.text: 「$$バルゴラ$$ is our pride...!\n I won't let you do any more damage!」

battle:666f7c0d27a70b36.text: 「If they can read my trajectory,\n I'll just change my movement pattern...!」

battle:1962b7484e2557ef.text: 「...I won't scream...!\n I'm a warrior, too!」

battle:632b81b539432b24.text: 「When I'm in a tight spot,\n I need to remember everything I've learned...!」

battle:644060218cfe2788.text: 「$$グローリー・スター$$ is a star of glory...!\n It won't fall!」
battle:644060218cfe2788.notes: 栄光の星 is a literal explanation of the Glory Star name here; lowercase star of glory retained as explanatory prose, not a competing proper name.

battle:0bb22467475f7d05.text: 「I won't let myself be taken down so easily...!」

battle:94d37003a3f9a915.text: 「My mission is to return alive...!\n I refuse to die!」

battle:7dececdd80c7c18a.text: 「Grit your teeth...!\n If you scream, it's all over!」

battle:0548da566304237b.text: 「I won't let $$グローリー・スター$$'s fight\n end here!」

battle:edc8de269d285f7d.text: 「I won't let you...!\n On my pride, I'll protect $$バルゴラ$$!」

battle:f07ea7e1cee4b136.text: 「I couldn't protect...\n $$グローリー・スター$$'s pride...」

battle:862107aebf3220f8.text: 「$$グローリー・スター$$'s pride\n is with me!」

battle:0318b51e29448d16.text: 「To sweep away the sorrow in this world...!」

battle:839b0c18901d65a9.text: 「I won't give in to sorrow...!\n That's my fight!」

battle:f6f1ad33228ad5e5.text: 「If this helps pay off even a little of the debt...!」

battle:bf6eddec1fc96874.text: 「Just what I'd expect from you, $$クロウ$$!」

battle:218eb52b75e2d314.text: 「I can't stand by and watch you fall deeper into debt!」

battle:8e30b924304eee71.text: 「You're too far out in front, $$クロウ$$!」

battle:9e10d96f20353697.text: 「I won't let you take down $$ガンレオン$$...!」

battle:80e561cc18faf792.text: 「Concentrate on the enemy in front of me...!」

battle:3480255d1bf38290.text: 「This is what I need to do right now...!」

battle:05baaef573d10547.text: 「$$バルゴラ$$... Lend me your strength again...!」

battle:c1609b6faf859af7.text: 「Its movement and maneuverability have been improved...!」

battle:6850cbd5e821a1fc.text: 「I'll cast aside my hesitation and stop you!」

battle:0711e744ce7d00df.text: 「Strike at the heart of the enemy's command structure...!」

battle:0f1ff28110e50b82.text: 「I won't hand Earth over to you...!」

battle:41adaba7e72b30c8.text: 「To free the people from your rule...!」

battle:956abccecdf20fcd.text: 「People all over the world are still resisting...!」

battle:21fda59e07cd3187.text: 「I'll pay you back, $$サルディアス$$!」

battle:9c8bdf6b1575b690.text: 「There is no hesitation\n or doubt within me...!」

battle:fff9a629bdd48040.text: 「Your hatred and sorrow...!\n I won't let them spread any further!」

battle:f0a20955a104141d.text: 「Your cowardly tricks end here, $$ギルター$$!」

battle:4e7909a224ba2441.text: 「I can't hand my $$スフィア$$\n over to you!」

battle:f4d5533e5e4ce62c.text: 「Even if my opponent\n surpasses me as a $$リアクター$$...!」

battle:870be59fe1ef68a0.text: 「I... won't run from the fate of the $$スフィア$$s...!」

battle:a8ea33a1c1be6576.text: 「$$バルビエル$$...!\n I won't be swallowed by your hatred!」

battle:b57098cc96ea2d7a.text: 「Hatred breeds sorrow...!\n That's why I'll stop you!」

battle:df2d794715c08349.text: 「Before that bottomless darkness\n draws me in...!」

battle:0bafc2fbd3e1dc5b.text: 「If I let my guard down for even a moment,\n that murderous intent will swallow me...!」

battle:e2cbb074abc21a06.text: 「Evade and counterattack in a single motion...!」

battle:fa7f7b113abc289d.text: 「I won't give you an opening to retreat...!」

battle:656c7e01c61958d8.text: 「Match the timing of the enemy's retreat...!」

battle:5781796d749171ed.text: 「I'll take them down one at a time!」

battle:6ffed68aa4e892f6.text: 「Follow up while I keep them in check!」

battle:6844391a1169d767.text: 「All my means of counterattacking have been cut off...!」

battle:d401065a61e26611.text: 「If I can't make a move,\n I'll find a way...!」

battle:e9754d8c06c9d04b.text: 「I can't wait until I see it to move...!」

battle:514bfccd492e46d8.text: 「If I can read three moves ahead...!」

battle:cf773935577f9730.text: 「$$グローリー・スター$$ won't fall...!」

battle:2250302038367284.text: 「If I draw out 100%\n of $$エイクロス$$'s capabilities...!」

battle:42e52ba2c4989e01.text: 「Now I can draw out $$バルゴラ$$'s power...!」

battle:887cb24fad8b8ef1.text: 「I can't take the $$スフィア$$'s power\n head-on...!」

battle:5fe94a7eda7fca7b.text: 「If I can stop it where the armor is thick...!」

battle:746da73ab77cdf3b.text: 「If I lose focus, I'm done for...!」

battle:5c52119124fa1a09.text: 「I wouldn't call this much\n a crisis...!」

battle:c38f36d13b8c90d6.text: 「If they can read my trajectory,\n I'll just move faster...!」

battle:9458781df267675b.text: 「I can't keep\n being pushed back like this...!」

battle:9f94e5550c0b2087.text: 「Now is when the right stuff is put to the test...!」

battle:ce3e398e3a6458ef.text: 「As long as there's pride in my heart, I'll keep fighting...!」

battle:1348dbc18ba327b5.text: 「I won't lose to sorrow or the enemy...!\n I can't lose!」

battle:96903027dde4ed5f.text: 「What I've gained from all my battles\n will help me through this crisis...!」

battle:43f53e78bdb764ad.text: 「Hold out just a little longer, $$エイクロス$$!」

battle:d1069b5c651ec718.text: 「I can't shake the enemy, even in $$バルゴラ$$...!」

battle:87820af985c3a411.text: 「I'm being swallowed... by $$バルビエル$$'s hatred...!」

battle:4438264c81184c38.text: 「So this is the power of $$サイデリアル$$'s $$リアクター$$s...!」

battle:f4611883db6e409a.text: 「To everyone playing, thank you for your hard work. Please take a good rest.」

battle:ebf5ad027aa7668a.text: 「I'm a little tired myself, so I think I'll have something sweet and take a break.」

battle:423744ba2579c8e1.text: 「Did you know? Chocolate goes well with beer.」

battle:a36575e644924905.text: 「I'll be careful not to drink too much and end up regretting it. Well, everyone... Until next time.」

battle:def9f2378b1654d9.text: 「If there's a chance, I'll take it!」

battle:19036c5028103ea8.text: 「This $$エイクロス$$\n is part of $$グローリー・スター$$, too...!」

battle:0c68de91450506f1.text: 「With the power of the $$スフィア$$ in the $$カーバー$$...!」

battle:46f9c9c4a898b980.text: 「I'll channel the $$スフィア$$'s power into an attack!」

battle:a61d0b0ab36bb9d8.text: 「The $$カーバー$$ can be used like this, too!」

battle:ebe4e9dfbb0fed8f.text: 「$$グローリー・スター$$'s pride\n is with me...!」

battle:9e6e53725b9eda63.text: 「$$ナウティラス・カーバー$$...! With your power!」

battle:af2c48bb891a5138.text: 「This action was perfected\n through the efforts of many people.」

battle:84ca82d55225027a.text: 「I can feel it... The $$スフィア$$ inside the $$カーバー$$...!」

battle:5619f14fdf497ad1.text: 「If I put $$バルゴラ$$'s speed into the strike...!」

battle:c657156e90ef57f8.text: 「I'll show you the essence\n of $$ＧＳコンバット・アクション$$!」

battle:47600c25c5bd645a.text: 「First Approach!\n Throw the enemy off balance!」

battle:0c3d0e350de999dc.text: 「$$バルゴラ$$ and I become one!」

battle:25f56409728a2490.text: 「I'll draw out everything $$バルゴラ$$ has...!」

battle:3b2fc0d9f1455209.text: 「Answer me, $$スフィア$$ of the $$悲しみの乙女$$...!」

battle:da0a207610ec8cf9.text: 「$$ザ・グローリー・スター$$!\n Full Shoot!!」

battle:c831880a92ef4f9e.text: 「Together with everyone's feelings\n that this $$バルゴラ$$ carries...!」

battle:ff283f31abbd69f2.text: 「With the pride of $$グローリー・スター$$ in my heart...!」

battle:13497c26a8890199.text: 「$$バルゴラ$$ and I will become one!」

battle:c2b26d59ececee37.text: 「$$ザ・グローリー・スター$$!\n Full Burst!!」

battle:aae0e7a16e0a6646.text: 「Sorrow... is covering my heart and the world...」

battle:02db10c9eda2b9b5.text: 「$$ギルター$$... You are... so sad...」
battle:02db10c9eda2b9b5.notes: 悲しい can be sorrowful or pitiable here; retained ambiguous so sad rather than assigning Gilter an emotion/reason. Independent proof: 悲しい directed at Gilter can express sorrow or pity; existing ambiguous 'so sad' is defensible and the existing needs_review remains appropriate.

battle:5fe13c9f3fe1de93.text: 「Turn my feelings... everyone's feelings into power...」

battle:7a3375e56335acb0.text: 「That is the meaning of my life...」

battle:1ddf5fb6411e085a.text: 「What I can do together with someone...」

battle:e2e9663884c4e233.text: 「I'll search... for what I can do...」

battle:05f1d019ed63ca3d.text: 「As long as... I have this $$バルゴラ$$...」

battle:7c08e1786c421216.text: 「The $$スフィア$$... envelops $$バルゴラ$$ and me...」

battle:92d9fcdc39791438.text: 「I'll drive this in, then tear you apart...!」

battle:da4073725fabbfb0.text: 「All right! Let's set the soul on fire!」

battle:165683b35084fec2.text: 「I'm a repairman!\n I'll hammer that crooked attitude straight!!」

battle:0880470e261f5b95.text: 「This is $$ビーター・サービス$$,\n the wandering repair crew!」

battle:f405a7963edfd927.text: 「I'll stomp the accelerator right through the floor!」

battle:69a562b1811df848.text: 「They don't call me $$ザ・ヒート$$ for nothing!」

battle:edae26cb3f8f32e8.text: 「I don't care if you're the military,\n I'll do things my way!」

battle:f1c7eb9aa34755be.text: 「All the way from space, huh?\n You sure went to a lot of trouble!」

battle:0026b848e66b5959.text: 「You rampaging aliens!\n Hurry up and go back to your own planet!!」

battle:eed40b4de8f8b76c.text: 「Your sightseeing trip to Earth ends here!」

battle:3ccd61c3ec8ecb10.text: 「My tools of the trade can be used like this, too!」

battle:6574e7ac39ff4bd8.text: 「It's all in how you use your head and your tools!!」

battle:634277d522782298.text: 「You can use a spanner like this, too!」

battle:76013d4d7d1dcce4.text: 「One's a spanner! Two are still spanners!」
battle:76013d4d7d1dcce4.notes: Retains literal one/two spanner joke instead of inventing a new object or cultural reference.

battle:d19bc9d74fee9bcb.text: 「Acrobatic fighting technique! $$ブンマー・スパナ$$!!」

battle:b2dd2791cd405e4f.text: 「An extra-special service! Have all you want!!」

battle:bda8f81e9b0826e5.text: 「Heh heh heh... My own heat scares me.」

battle:2d68193abb07c76e.text: 「See that? That's how $$ザ・ヒート$$ lives!」

battle:5ae2322f907b24ba.text: 「Oh, crap... There go the nasty rumors again...!」

battle:a5a59642d22373f2.text: 「Spare me the cheering that takes the wind out of my sails!」

battle:8094a520c2015c09.notes: Deliberate ブンブン vs ブンマー variation; do not normalize to the real Bunmar Spanner call. Independent proof: The source deliberately says ブンブン, not ブンマー. Boom-Boom preserves the sound joke and remains distinct from the real Bunmar Spanner call. Meaning is confirmed; any remaining flag concerns English joke phrasing.

battle:ea896ed6090729bd.text: 「This is the famous $$ブンマー・スパナ$$!」

battle:7b14019635f5b2c3.notes: Deliberate ガンガンモード spoken variation; not silently normalized to Magna Mode. Independent proof: ガンガンモード is the intentionally wrong spoken name, corrected later to Magna Mode. Bang-Bang keeps the distinction; retain a humor-rendering flag if final phrasing is still undecided, not an identity correction.

battle:5454280c8d80ae52.text: 「Let's do it, $$メール$$! Burn it all up!!」

battle:e6d0f75a8998c23e.text: 「Well... Something like this is a piece of cake.」

battle:49cd401d15f46412.text: 「Sorry.\n I'm too old to play your little games.」

battle:7d7c00d6314d7949.text: 「How about that, $$メール$$! Give me some praise!!」

battle:1afe713558748a50.text: 「Hmph...\n This is no worse than a bee sting.」

battle:02dcf83f85981e36.text: 「You don't get it. Scars are a man's medals.」

battle:5e66fdb7e4d3fa5b.text: 「Quit screaming your head off!\n You're doing serious damage to my eardrums!」

battle:c4afb50d681ed40f.text: 「Quiet, $$メール$$.\n That one's pretty damn good...!」

battle:474d0515e33c4428.text: 「Don't bring up that kind of harsh reality!」

battle:ba2d2984ce0d2ff6.text: 「You bastard! How dare you!\n How dare you do that!!」

battle:5aacb72eccd63430.text: 「$$メール$$! Did you bang into anything!?」
battle:5aacb72eccd63430.notes: Meaning proof: どっかぶつけてねえか asks whether Mel bumped herself during the hit, alongside the next injury check. 'Did you hit anything' can instead sound like a question about landing an attack; make the bodily collision clear.

battle:0bcc843bf3a73260.text: 「Sorry, $$メール$$...!\n For putting you through all this!」

battle:4fa5d2e221d7fc4e.text: 「Pack up, $$メール$$!\n If things get bad, we're bailing out!」

battle:a122110a372ec64b.text: 「What are you talking about at a time like this!?」

battle:f9a738e2a6419788.text: 「Bail out, $$メール$$!\n Don't forget the valuables!!」

battle:95a90dbe9b6a5426.text: 「Why, hello again from your familiar wandering repair crew, $$ビーター・サービス$$! Our honest service and our employees' smiles are our pride and joy!」

battle:e63af3d4350de3ae.text: 「『Love』! That one word sums up the relationship between people and machines!」

battle:17cdbf854df96d30.text: 「When that happens, give the console a full-force chop at a 45-degree angle from the right!!」

battle:b84f26a90ec2745c.text: 「If you're just gonna stand there,\n I'll give you another hit!!」

battle:b5623d0bfe309aed.text: 「I'm not missing out on the party!」

battle:18f86af143b097c1.text: 「Preventing damage is a repairman's job, too!」

battle:f515148169d60ffa.text: 「Geez!\n You're making extra work for me!」

battle:fc646531e3f959a3.text: 「Even a meeting like this must be fate!」

battle:79e119642f4aff8a.text: 「Hang on, leader!\n I'll lead the charge!」

battle:0603ae57e593f391.text: 「Whoops! I went too hard at the start!」

battle:217fc0a6cd113676.text: 「What am I doing!?\n I'm a shooting-gallery target like this!」

battle:30afaf389b30f421.text: 「My slack was spacing...\n I mean, my spacing was slack!」
battle:30afaf389b30f421.notes: Source deliberately reverses 甘い/間合い, then self-corrects. Retained a spacing/slack reversal; humor wording needs review. Independent proof: The source swaps 甘い and 間合い before correcting itself. Existing spacing/slack reversal preserves the mistake and correct tactical meaning; humor phrasing remains needs_review rather than silently replacing the joke.

battle:21bdbccfd4ae2149.text: 「Oops! Looks like I misjudged the distance!」

battle:ff240b3fec847237.text: 「Tch!\n That customer sure left in a hurry!」

battle:daaedf8bd9724fe9.text: 「Heh! This is a piece of cake!」

battle:be1a9d622470ad17.text: 「It's no joke\n when a repairman takes damage!」

battle:debb7db9779f3f18.text: 「My wild guess paid off! It's my lucky day!」

battle:df0d4c755740b5f6.text: 「I've hated getting punched\n ever since I was a kid!」

battle:6ff3269ab59c71ac.text: 「I've gotta handle\n $$ガンレオン$$'s repairs myself, you know.」

battle:9888683e07ec4913.text: 「Looks like your sights aren't working right.」

battle:629a22840d4ff74d.text: 「All right! Thank goodness for the barrier!」

battle:b5bde04c0c7512af.text: 「Sure am glad I installed a barrier!」

battle:c205ba2803d79564.text: 「Okay!\n Now I know exactly what you're capable of!」

battle:3ce3396150bf539f.text: 「You bastard!\n Fixing that scratch isn't free, you know!」

battle:dcc802c2610039b0.text: 「You dimwit! If you wanna take me down,\n hit me a hundred times harder!」

battle:aae47e3ca3cb8e85.text: 「If those are the only weapons you've got,\n the repair business'll be slow.」

battle:e4d54e9b4b37198f.text: 「For $$ガンレオン$$,\n that's not even a scratch...!」

battle:a839ac18cfde6e0b.text: 「Thanks.\n That might even fix my stubborn stiff shoulders.」

battle:ea7939ddb894702b.text: 「Whoa! I saw sparks right in front of me!」

battle:27793c6d305bab7f.text: 「Dented armor, huh...\n I'll need a press for this.」

battle:8a625e282a49931c.text: 「Yeah, that's it...!\n I'm getting fired up, too!」

battle:5f82a3dd3b4034db.text: 「That packed a punch...! But\n it's nothing next to the boss's fists!」

battle:31d653cb5fbdb304.text: 「This might be a little much\n to endure on guts alone...!」

battle:445b664f22f22ca9.text: 「Tch!\n Which of us is $$ザ・クラッシャー$$ here!?」

battle:154842e8cadcd5b3.text: 「This is bad! If it's totally wrecked,\n even I can't fix it!」

battle:63b67183138fffc3.text: 「Heh heh... Brings back the old days...!」

battle:cc9d16f6fd429f8a.text: 「I'm $$ザ・ヒート$$!\n It's too soon to back down!」

battle:3264c606ee85a014.text: 「Looks like this really is\n gonna be a fight to the death...!」

battle:5717862b42470c90.text: 「A wrench for large ships! This'll pack a punch!」

battle:d97ce3ec4e64c8c0.text: 「$$ビーター・サービス$$'s signature tool!」

battle:d39611b1b7db5257.text: 「The $$ジャレンチ$$ isn't just for show!」

battle:48f1a2ef8e6acd96.text: 「This is\n the $$ライアット・ジャレンチ$$!!」

battle:66ffadad325a70bd.text: 「$$ビーター殺法$$! Machine Mega Crush!!」
battle:66ffadad325a70bd.notes: Independent proof: マシン大圧殺 is a coined attack call about crushing a machine, rendered Machine Mega Crush. No established English call verified; retain needs_review for the call wording. It must remain distinct from3187 Machine Mega Destruction (大破壊).

battle:f9f27d9c14f1a0f3.text: 「About the only ones who can handle this\n are me and the boss!」

battle:182568232d6e1e8b.text: 「That's about what happens when I get serious!」

battle:866b977b2322ac82.text: 「Just so you know, that's beyond repair!」

battle:3c9e09d3135be123.text: 「Roar with all your might, $$ガンレオン$$!」

battle:15f668231c2af0bc.text: 「It's a close encounter!\n We won't lose!」

battle:85b4f761f0e16893.text: 「At this rate,\n we're gonna get beaten to a pulp!」

battle:c20b4e925683925b.text: 「$$ガンレオン$$'s toughness is its selling point!」

battle:cf00a67e7cda96a0.text: 「The $$ガンレオン$$ Papa left us\n is invincible!」

battle:722cf9ed1c9309d5.text: 「You did it now! I won't forgive you!」

battle:f1cfb2ef47b99601.text: 「Aaah!\n Not even $$ガンレオン$$ can take any more!」

battle:77fcc1b1f8971308.text: 「I'm not scared...!\n I believe in my darling!」

battle:95be6585d50777f5.text: 「Darling! Let's go, even if we take a loss!」

battle:a8a1ff742066df43.notes: Source deliberately says 百発 (a hundred shots), not familiar 一発 catchphrase. Number preserved. Independent proof: 百発 explicitly means a hundred shots, deliberately differing from the familiar one-shot catchphrase. Number and joke are preserved; remaining needs_review concerns natural English comic delivery, not changing the number.

battle:41c9248c37c8ab53.text: 「Enemy approaching! Right? Um, left?\n I don't know anymore!」

battle:7850b8b380006b52.text: 「Way to go, darling! I'm falling for you all over again!」

battle:1853383d7a27d372.text: 「There you go, trying to look cool again!」

battle:3c9af77729894b05.text: 「Wonderful! The best! $$ザ・ヒート$$!\n ...Will that do?」

battle:18b86d758690cc24.text: 「We're fine, we're fine! That's $$ガンレオン$$ for you!」

battle:70ee327c8383d48c.text: 「Oh, no!\n The repair bill's going to put us in the red!」

battle:e6ba5d9060ee4aef.notes: ペチャ treated as flat-chest joke based on root research of Mel and lack of any named Pecha evidence; specific body-part inference remains needs_review. Meaning proof: ペチャ describes flatness without naming a body part. Removing the added chest follows the omitted-information policy and keeps the joke open; nearby dialogue also mentions injured noses, so the specific body part is not established. Independent proof: Flatness joke remains needs_review until paired voice/animation context establishes its referent. Do not invent a named Pecha or fix the body part as chest.

battle:2581222b928db032.text: 「I-I'm fine,\n but your nose is bleeding, darling!」

battle:96bbd1a25b18c8ff.text: 「We promised not to say that, darling!」

battle:775c504f20c17649.text: 「You can do it, darling!\n Don't lose, $$ガンレオン$$!」

battle:3ed99cc400030f49.text: 「Th-they're too good!\n They're too good, darling!!」
battle:3ed99cc400030f49.notes: Same-bank3210 explicitly states enemy is too good; this line corrected to enemy skill, darling is the addressee.

battle:775818631f72fdf8.text: 「Today, our company would like to give all you players some advice on getting along with your game consoles.」

battle:21368de743344b8a.text: 「...Darling, $$ガンレオン$$ doesn't seem to be running well...」

battle:cdbacea4c9ff9195.text: 「...That was an example of what not to do. Everyone, please take good care of your game consoles.」

battle:41a8a9b73cfcfd24.text: 「$$ビーター・サービス$$ is here!」

battle:12403c0c72c95561.text: 「That's $$ビーター・サービス$$'s\n business policy!」

battle:05290e332dd01212.notes: 当たって砕けろ idiom encouragement has ominous literal shatter/die undertone, picked up by Rand's 3066 bad-luck objection. Do or die preserves this double function. Independent proof: Do or die preserves the encouragement plus ominous literal shattering risk that triggers Rand's3066 objection. Meaning is supported by paired banter; any remaining flag is for comic phrasing.

battle:90cdbcfb028ca44f.text: 「This is no time to take a breather!」
battle:90cdbcfb028ca44f.notes: ついてる resumes 一息つく; nearby 3069 ほっと一息 confirms breather, not being lucky.

battle:21e5987c0ea4d9f9.text: 「No matter where I am, I'm a repairman!」

battle:857c1bf7d4271f71.text: 「Going a little overboard now and then is part of my charm!」

battle:94c4a38957ca44f6.text: 「Let's really turn up the heat, $$ガンレオン$$!」

battle:f6de32f53d3e12f4.text: 「Once I decide to do something, I go all the way!」

battle:a1d68b69eb7a0f22.text: 「That's what I was waiting to hear!」

battle:93547c53a9c8ce7c.text: 「It's business as usual at $$ビーター・サービス$$!」

battle:cfde2e1024fff460.text: 「Don't say things that bring bad luck!」

battle:897a85f995e60ce5.text: 「You don't wanna add to your debt, do you, brother!?」

battle:c05456a0089fb7a3.text: 「Consider this my apology for what happened before!」

battle:f4ac53c2da36a5e1.text: 「Giving my all to repairs and fighting:\n that's my motto!」

battle:75fe41f65fd6f9ea.text: 「Sometimes you fix things by hitting them!」

battle:f048d9c5fcd47541.text: 「Piloting this brings back my younger days!」

battle:6795c7369c938fe6.text: 「It's been a while! You're fired up, $$ガンレオン$$!」

battle:4761a2cd6f890551.text: 「I've been waiting for this day, $$ガンレオン$$!\n The day I'd see you again!」

battle:7e7040b97c02f95c.text: 「The extra service\n comes with a burning-hot smile!」

battle:6b35697623e2eab7.text: 「Hang on! I'm coming to help you!」

battle:f93976ad7ee0b3e9.text: 「This'll be a little rough,\n but bear with me!」

battle:8816322b05f213b1.text: 「Since you've become an enemy,\n I'll just have to hit you with all I've got!」

battle:6a3e565a2ef88b92.text: 「As you know,\n I'm not a man who holds back!」

battle:d213bf9f8dcb7bcc.text: 「No matter how big it is, it's gotta have a weak spot!」

battle:91518d430f713913.text: 「If I got scared of a big opponent,\n I'd disgrace the name of $$ザ・ヒート$$!」

battle:eb71f2786bbff654.text: 「I'm good at taking battleships apart, too!」

battle:7c2a64af85b62cd1.text: 「Barging onto someone else's planet\n like you own the place...!」

battle:3725469c701dc93a.text: 「If you're gonna turn tail and run, now's the time,\n $$サイデリアル$$!」

battle:eac04dceb2fbdf47.text: 「You'll pay for tricking us,\n old man!」

battle:c687d6ba5fd43796.text: 「$$クラヴィア$$!\n If you won't stop...!」

battle:46f6665ac70b9537.text: 「Let all that hatred out,\n $$クラヴィア$$!」

battle:47ee0c7116b1e506.text: 「I'm sick and tired of your dirty tricks,\n $$ギルター$$!」

battle:471bb284ea572508.text: 「You, I won't forgive even if you apologize,\n $$ギルター$$!」

battle:9ebc02fddffc2dd1.text: 「If this is a fight with our $$スフィア$$s on the line,\n I'll take you on!」

battle:c956228135c2c301.text: 「Ugh, no thanks!\n People ought to live with a smile!」

battle:b203470d706a110b.text: 「$$尸空$$! My Heat Smile\n will sweep away your darkness!」
battle:b203470d706a110b.notes: Heat Smile is a literal spoken flourish; no additional ability or effect asserted.

battle:668fcac2fa58f261.text: 「All right! Leave the rest to me!」

battle:d889a94c6a4fd7b2.text: 「If you've got time to talk, fall back,\n $$ロジャー$$!」

battle:a6b20dd13051482a.text: 「Leave this one to me! That one's all yours!」

battle:b4b1c4565d998ff9.text: 「I'll open a way through for you!」

battle:822d3a9afa3856f6.text: 「Watching the enemy leave sure is depressing...」

battle:706a052e63651a82.text: 「That's about all there is to it!」

battle:8d9cebffdddcb37e.text: 「That was dangerous!\n What were you gonna do if it hit!?」

battle:d8ae3220ddcb861e.text: 「See that, $$メール$$!? ...Oh, right. You're not here...」

battle:9b2695e319165dcb.notes: まーグッドな pun on マグナ reproduced as ma-gnificent. No real mode renamed. Independent proof: Ma-gnificent adapts the source まーグッドな/Magna sound joke while leaving the mode's actual name intact. Meaning is sound; English pun style can remain flagged for final wording.

battle:e627217289576dbe.text: 「Looks like we're both\n being pushed around by our $$スフィア$$s!」

battle:0b0a817d31a85d06.text: 「An attack like that won't beat me,\n no matter how many times you try!」

battle:00923fe85de95a9b.text: 「I didn't get hit! I blocked it!」

battle:2e57f6ed385145d2.text: 「Whoa! I stepped on the accelerator too hard!」

battle:c590de978f31119c.text: 「Thanks! Now my engine\n is getting fired up!」

battle:0f9fed54ff4dacf8.text: 「Damn it! Then\n I'll just have to drag you into a slugfest!」

battle:1c2d7ff05de325a2.text: 「You bastard! You really went that far!?」

battle:d599db40c201cda2.text: 「I'm getting so fired up\n I'm about to boil over!」

battle:e54ca6b7b743f80c.text: 「Hang in there, $$ランボルト$$! Show some guts!」

battle:34cc42bf8e4d5bad.text: 「Even $$マグナモード$$\n took this much of a beating!?」

battle:812c3f4199bf8832.text: 「Damn it!\n You sure know how to use that $$スフィア$$!」

battle:348907a761763e8a.notes: ガンガンモード remains Bang-Bang Mode, deliberately corrected to Magna Mode by Mel at 3196. Independent proof: Bang-Bang Mode intentionally differs from Magna Mode, explicitly corrected at3196. Do not normalize the joke away; any remaining review is English soundplay wording.

battle:4687de186e5b45ed.text: 「Get fired up, $$メール$$! We're going all out!」

battle:2013239d4d3d2ef7.text: 「If you come at me, I won't hold back!」

battle:e296301ae77b883e.text: 「You make it sound like our business is going up in flames!」

battle:7ddebc98146b5dc3.text: 「A good day's work\n makes the food and beer taste great!」

battle:2b93e1084159b074.text: 「Here they come, $$メール$$! $$サイデリアル$$!」

battle:98ad2826a498ee0d.text: 「Don't think I'll forgive you, old man!」

battle:e1ec74537f4c63e9.text: 「No, $$メール$$!\n Force is the only way to stop this!」

battle:b3cc356f7c6d8319.text: 「This would be easy with my eyes closed.」

battle:266449cff874a840.text: 「I get it, so stop leaning forward!」

battle:fb7131295327cd3a.text: 「That doesn't mean it's okay to get hit!」

battle:db1b0d60c147d78b.text: 「What!? You mean it's been gouged out!?」
battle:db1b0d60c147d78b.notes: えぐれちまった keeps gouged out; no body part or cockpit component inserted.

battle:ef21ccc40f74be8a.text: 「$$メール$$! If it comes to this, at least you...」

battle:fb9ebf597c5474de.text: 「Get a grip, $$メール$$!\n Where did that come from!?」

battle:2005e8d91cb2e55c.text: 「You've gotta be prepared to use this!」

battle:0ad697e07e5baa55.text: 「I'll pound you with $$マグナモード$$'s power!」

battle:76f4c16ae1032c69.text: 「Let's go, $$メール$$! The ultimate $$ビーター殺法$$!」

battle:dfaf806ad4803ff9.text: 「I'll send up some fireworks with a bang!」

battle:a91eb1cf8899603a.text: 「Even without $$ガンレオン$$, I've got tools!」

battle:3109372ef1fb88a2.text: 「This machine can handle a spanner, too!」

battle:a62303cd9df3609c.text: 「I'll show you the $$ビーター殺法$$!」

battle:b480e1c0661252b7.text: 「$$ビーター殺法$$! Machine Mega Destruction!」
battle:b480e1c0661252b7.notes: 大破壊 distinct from 2959 大圧殺; Machine Mega Destruction vs Machine Mega Crush preserved. Independent proof: Machine Mega Destruction preserves 大破壊, distinct from 大圧殺's crushing at2959. Literal coined call is semantically sound but no established English wording has been verified.

battle:0ab3d0be6e754554.text: 「I'll show you the ultimate $$ビーター殺法$$!」

battle:464cb23437e82d1a.text: 「That feels great! Makes the beer taste good!」

battle:945ebd1015e7ac88.text: 「Oops...\n I might've hit it too hard and bent it out of shape...」

battle:df15d513c50a052a.text: 「I told you, it's $$マグナモード$$,\n darling!」

battle:a96a767193e783b9.text: 「Darling! Show me how cool you are!」

battle:cf30e8e71d09452e.text: 「Become a fireball and crash into them, $$ガンレオン$$!」

battle:775eccb0cd1baef3.text: 「$$ガンレオン$$'s full of energy today, too!」

battle:7174e549689a0d31.notes: パッとサイデリアル catchphrase soundplay; Presto, Sidereal is provisional, without inventing attack effects. Independent proof: パッとサイデリアル is opaque catchphrase soundplay. Presto preserves the sudden/exclamatory sense without assigning an attack effect; retain the existing needs_review.

battle:fa66d4589b6a658a.text: 「Darling can fix\n a scratch like this in no time!」

battle:4ce6794b74159aef.text: 「Of course!\n I'm pretty confident in my toughness, too!」

battle:59d5428a9d192985.text: 「Ow... My nose might be a centimeter flatter...」

battle:d513e97dbd04f770.text: 「Quit saying silly things and keep going,\n darling!」

battle:607ad966000f14c6.text: 「Th-the enemy's too good! Just too good!」
battle:607ad966000f14c6.notes: This explicit enemy-subject うますぎ supports interpreting the similar 3037 as enemy skill; earlier draft corrected accordingly.

battle:16ca2704e95bb427.text: 「Darling's the best spanner-spinner in the world!」

battle:85cd7030ee792d5d.text: 「Let's do it, darling!\n $$ペイン・シャウター$$!」

battle:ddb1e775a8a6a53a.text: 「Darling and $$ガンレオン$$ are burning up!」

battle:004ea3becb63db83.text: 「Today, I'm going all out! All the way!」

battle:c7f073826f350fcb.text: 「Sorry, but I'm taking my frustrations out on you!」

battle:e4982e19486ecbc7.text: 「It's no good...!\n I just have to smash something!」

battle:58a9ceb66e3c34ee.text: 「You're the enemy! That means it's okay to destroy you!」

battle:597ca9897a5725a9.text: 「Take the whole payload! It's a missile festival!」

battle:a9618b02180e37d5.text: 「Sorry, boss!\n Today, I'm using this to destroy things!」

battle:f6ca71235f13054c.text: 「It's no good! I can't stop myself!」

battle:dd2ea2fb38d8f984.text: 「Something's welling up from deep inside me!」

battle:dc710faddcbef50b.text: 「You hit me, so let me hit you!」

battle:53e28ebf0101aae7.text: 「It's not fair if only you get to hit!\n Let me do it, too!」

battle:9080786356d1853e.text: 「For hitting me, you get it back tenfold!」

battle:5a0ef52b688728f3.text: 「Don't get mad if I wreck it first!」

battle:b22a6ec060647a0a.text: 「I'm not letting the likes of you take me down!」

battle:1c85b1bf4e231260.text: 「I'm the one who destroys!\n You're the one who gets destroyed!」

battle:28f221c7b00322ff.text: 「All right! Since I got hit,\n it's okay for me to hit back!」

battle:5c01aa9b4a34ed3a.text: 「Not bad! I'm getting fired up, too!」

battle:92fe8d2f6f3863be.text: 「I'll just wreck you before you wreck me!」

battle:3a0011d10065ac47.text: 「Whoa! I'll get wrecked before I can wreck anything!」

battle:6452354dc7e1eff4.text: 「W-wait! I'm supposed to be the one destroying things!」

battle:0f51dfc1cf589191.text: 「I can see the flame of life.」

battle:59f1c87035ace2c1.text: 「This is as far as you go.」

battle:82e005db6394c5da.text: 「There is nothing beyond this for you.」

battle:326862bbd99a6607.text: 「Submit to the natural order and fate.」

battle:c0c7c9d5a55efdc8.text: 「You cannot escape the laws of existence.」

battle:f10b69f94e758c37.notes: 常世 rendered hereafter in explicit death/afterlife context; no named in-game location invented.

battle:e6d01a32dddbc0ae.notes: Uses current literal shared 尸魂 key, souls of the dead.

battle:e186419bb666ad26.text: 「My target is the flame of life.」

battle:c1c57e89b63833f6.text: 「It is time for the flame to go out.」

battle:5ee1705b2a4a4583.text: 「I will crush the chain of command.」

battle:132a81dcf9850231.text: 「I will take away your place to return to.」

battle:2f5ce44fe7b69ece.text: 「A $$スフィア・リアクター$$, then.」

battle:386b24c33d45b416.text: 「I will not let you use that power.」

battle:47e1b6950ef54874.text: 「Your life will vanish along with the light.」

battle:2f925d2703061593.text: 「These claws open the gate of death.」

battle:aabd918603c017bf.text: 「I will guide you to the underworld.」

battle:9ecc2af5b25fbd5e.notes: Current shared 尸冥爪 key confirmed as unit Shimeisou.

battle:1e005b28611ac36d.text: 「All that remains is to finish you.」

battle:b7ef428cd50b2dfa.text: 「$$尸刻$$, please leave the rest to me.」

battle:964d0eb8c10b15de.text: 「It is too soon for you to die.」

battle:d3678e27159196ed.text: 「I will leave that opponent to you.」

battle:579ce0eea6bd88b6.text: 「All I can do is watch you leave.」

battle:20f675fe6ba5fcf4.text: 「I have been caught in a trap.」

battle:fb9b5d69a0676f0f.text: 「There will not be a second time.」

battle:1f94f3837c6265b0.notes: 見えていない object absent; no added 'me' or specific target.

battle:5b0099b79c5bbcfc.text: 「You do not live up to the name $$ガンダム$$.」

battle:def893894724451d.text: 「It seems you do not know how to use your power.」

battle:bd7cf7c3e1ed58ca.text: 「Hard to believe you wield a $$スフィア$$.」

battle:3e593da21d28f844.text: 「I told you, it will not work.」

battle:c191c7d46510e0b7.notes: 尸冥爪 confirmed by root as unit Shimeisou; now uses exact shared reference.

battle:2781e4d3af3477e5.text: 「It seems you cannot pierce this machine's armor.」

battle:2fa94b3ffd6ee208.text: 「Even so, it is still not enough.」

battle:790bcfb7fefe8b74.text: 「I will give you no more openings.」

battle:fb4f0ee109f369a6.text: 「I do not make the same mistake twice.」

battle:0e6a9d37aff12a91.text: 「I am being pushed back, little by little...?」

battle:49b6fc81fbd2c5d3.text: 「You are learning to master the $$スフィア$$.」

battle:0d86d71410835891.text: 「As expected of a $$スフィア・リアクター$$.」

battle:12be976ec825b165.text: 「The enemy's fighting strength is greater, then.」

battle:77ff183ee46c4ea4.text: 「So this is the power of life.」

battle:c71902ddec9946ce.text: 「From here on, it is kill or be killed.」

battle:0d52c02f6a8178eb.text: 「The feeling of being side by side with death...」

battle:3b8254c6f4f33850.text: 「Merely the difference between sending and being sent.」

battle:0fdc7aeb3c2db17a.text: 「To think I... would end up like this...」

battle:dd4aa711f9de82aa.text: 「I will admit it was well done...」

battle:8f799f6dcb858d5b.text: 「$$鬼宿$$'s history... will soon end, too...」

battle:935fdc8aa03ee1e5.text: 「There is no place for us... in this universe...」

battle:727bc5761697ce2a.notes: Entire ellipsis utterance preserved verbatim; no meaning invented.

battle:a9a7a60e1ae8d37f.text: 「How has such a small machine driven me into a corner!?」

battle:16885fb1a4a7fc76.text: 「I do not intend to drag this out.」

battle:f7002a82db79b06d.text: 「You look likely to become a skilled wielder.」

battle:43ddbc9d8256fcc5.text: 「$$揺れる天秤$$... You alone, I must defeat.」

battle:95577cf76c84d7d6.text: 「Were you led astray by ghostly flames?」

battle:47dfdbbde2a5405d.text: 「Is that the extent of your power?」

battle:dd45b107dd80a552.text: 「Little by little, things are slipping out of place.」

battle:e277a4d5f329f2fa.text: 「I need only make it hold out.」

battle:f35d958e5fce0073.text: 「For $$鬼宿$$ to be in this state...」

battle:953337b8406735d5.text: 「I have nothing in particular to say.」

battle:dd7aedb43a29f09b.text: 「But keep playing the game. That is all.」

battle:1669f3b7a5cf35ec.text:
「So this is all there is to it...
 What a joke. Honestly.」

「I-I'm sorry!
